Poppler pdfdetach 24.03.0 through 26.11.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability in utils/pdfdetach.cc that allows attackers to write files outside the output directory by bypassing a string-prefix containment check. Attackers can craft PDFs with embedded file names containing '..' sequences or absolute paths, so -saveall or -savefile extraction creates or overwrites files with the invoking user's privileges.

Poppler pdftohtml through 26.11.0 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in HtmlLink::getLinkStart() in utils/HtmlLinks.cc that writes PDF link annotation URIs into href attributes without escaping in HTML output modes. Attackers can craft a PDF whose /URI entry contains a double quote followed by HTML markup or event handlers to execute script in browsers viewing the generated HTML.

Poppler through 26.11.0 contains an uncontrolled memory allocation vulnerability in the libcurl-based remote file loader that trusts unvalidated HEAD Content-Length values in CurlCachedFileLoader::init(). Malicious HTTP servers can return an enormous Content-Length so CachedFile resizes its chunk cache accordingly, aborting pdfinfo or PDFDocFactory-based applications with std::bad_alloc for denial of service.

Poppler 21.01.0 through 26.11.0 contains a time-of-check time-of-use race condition in FormWidgetSignature::signDocument() that allows local attackers to obtain valid signatures over altered content. Attackers with write access to the output file or directory can overwrite or swap the PDF between writing and hashing, causing the signer's key to sign attacker-controlled content.

Poppler 0.76.1 through 26.11.0 contains a heap-based buffer overflow in SplashOutputDev::iccTransform() that allows attackers to write out of bounds when rendering in splashModeDeviceN8. Attackers can supply a PDF with an ICCBased image whose alternate is DeviceN, causing getDeviceNLine() to overflow the per-row buffer, crashing the renderer and corrupting heap memory.

Poppler through 26.11.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in NSSCryptoSignBackend.cc that allows attackers to trigger reads of freed CMS arena memory during repeated signature verification. Attackers can supply a signed PDF embedding the signer certificate to crash applications or pdfsig runs validating multiple signatures, or cause incorrect certificate validation results.

Snap7 through 1.4.3 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in TSnap7MicroClient::opReadMultiVars() that allows malicious PLCs to overflow client buffers via unchecked DataLength fields. Attackers controlling or impersonating a PLC can return crafted ReadVar responses to Cli_ReadMultiVars() callers, writing up to 65535 bytes per item to corrupt memory and crash clients.

Snap7 through 1.4.3 contains a heap-based buffer overflow in TSnap7MicroClient::opReadSZL() that allows malicious PLCs to overwrite client memory by sending oversized multi-slice SZL responses. A rogue or impersonated PLC can keep flagging more data with attacker-controlled DLen slices, overflowing the 65536-byte opData buffer via Cli_ReadSZL() and Cli_ReadSZLList(), crashing the client and corrupting heap memory.

ILIAS 11.0 before 11.6 contains an sql injection vulnerability in RegistrationCodeRepository::getCodesData() that concatenates unvalidated sort fields into an ORDER BY clause. Authenticated users with read access to the Authentication and Registration administration node can supply SQL expressions as the sort parameter to extract database contents via boolean-based inference.

ILIAS before 9.25, 10.13, and 11.6 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in ilPRGAssignmentFilter::toConditions() that allows authenticated users to inject SQL through the StudyProgramme members list Name and Status filters. Attackers holding only the OrgUnit permission to view members can break out of LIKE literals and execute stacked statements, such as overwriting the root password hash to gain administrative control.

OwnTracks Recorder before 1.0.5 contains a format string vulnerability in json_response() and related output functions that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute code by storing a malicious tid value. Attackers can publish locations via POST /pub or MQTT with printf specifiers in tid, then read them back through GET /api/0/last to leak addresses and write memory.

Ettercap through 0.8.5.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in dissector_ssh() in src/dissectors/ec_ssh.c that copies a peer-supplied data_len without checking remaining packet bytes. A malicious SSHv1 client or server in an intercepted session can send a short packet with a large data_len to disclose up to 64 bytes of adjacent heap memory through captured credentials in the interface and log.

Ettercap through 0.8.5.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in dissector_mysql() in src/dissectors/ec_mysql.c that copies seed and password bytes without bounds checks. A malicious MySQL server or client can send truncated greeting or login packets to leak adjacent heap memory through hex-encoded output in the interface and log.

Ettercap through 0.8.5.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in dissector_vnc() in src/dissectors/ec_vnc.c that checks total packet length instead of remaining bytes. A malicious VNC server can send the authentication type and challenge in one short packet to leak up to 3 bytes of adjacent heap memory via the logged challenge.

Pika before 1.5.0 contains an uncontrolled resource allocation vulnerability that allows malicious brokers to exhaust client memory by declaring oversized frame payloads. Attackers can send frame headers declaring up to 4 GiB payloads, unchecked against frame_max, or very large message bodies to terminate consuming applications.

Supergateway 4.2.0 through 4.2.2 contains a denial of service vulnerability in stdio-to-SSE mode that allows unauthenticated attackers to crash the gateway via prototype-inherited sessionId values. Attackers can send a POST message request with sessionId set to toString or constructor, triggering an unhandled TypeError that terminates every attached MCP session.

IO::Socket::SSL::PublicSuffix versions through 2.099 for Perl allow code injection via a fetched list line that closes the built-in data heredoc when update_self_from_url rewrites the module's source.

The rewrite copies the module's source down to the built-in list's heredoc and appends each fetched line below it. Nothing checks that a line looks like a domain. A line that is not a comment loses only what follows a `//` and its trailing whitespace, so a line reading END_BUILTIN_DATA is appended as it stands and ends the data block in the rewritten file. Every fetched line after it is Perl.

Arbitrary Perl runs in every process that loads IO::Socket::SSL, which loads this module unconditionally, until the file is reinstalled. The attacker must control the fetched list, through the cleartext default URL or a caller-supplied one, and the updater must run with write access to the installed module.

CVSS 3.1 Base Score 9.1 (Confidentiality and Integrity impacts).  CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:N).

IO::Socket::SSL::PublicSuffix versions through 2.099 for Perl let an on-path attacker choose the installed public suffix list because update_self_from_url fetches it over cleartext HTTP with no integrity check.

Called with no argument, as the module's documentation shows, the updater fetches the list from the `http://` address in the URL constant and checks only that the request succeeded, with no signature or digest over the response. The lines that come back are written into the module's own source file as the built-in list.

An attacker on the network path when the updater runs chooses the suffix boundary the module reports to every caller on the host, and that answer persists in the installed module until it is reinstalled. Dropping one rule makes the hostname check in IO::Socket::SSL accept a wildcard certificate that spans the whole public suffix that rule named.

Netgate pfSense CE XMLRPC Incorrect Authorization Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Netgate pfSense. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the XMLRPC endpoint. The issue results from incorrect authorization prior to allowing access to functionality. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code within the context of the root. Was ZDI-CAN-32353.

Winmate HotTab Exposed Dangerous Function Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of Winmate devices. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the HotTab driver. The issue results from an exposed dangerous function. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of the kernel. Was ZDI-CAN-29948.

Philips Hue Bridge HomeKit Observable Discrepancy Information Disclosure Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of Philips Hue Bridge. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the HomeKit Authentication service, which listens on TCP port 8080 by default. When processing crafted pairing requests, the service discloses internal information via an observable discrepancy between possible responses. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute arbitrary code in the context of the device. Was ZDI-CAN-28470.

Philips Hue Bridge HomeKit Accessory Protocol chacha20_decrypt Integer Underflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Philips Hue Bridge. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the HomeKit Accessory Protocol service, which listens on TCP port 8080 by default. When parsing pairing requests, the process does not properly validate user-supplied data, which can result in an integer underflow before writing to memory. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the device. Was ZDI-CAN-28332.

Philips Hue Bridge hap_pair_setup_handler Heap-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Philips Hue Bridge. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the HomeKit Accessory Protocol service, which listens on TCP port 8080 by default. When parsing pairing requests, the process does not properly validate the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length, heap-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the device. Was ZDI-CAN-28434.

Philips Hue Bridge HomeKit Pair-Setup Default Password Authentication Bypass Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of Philips Hue Bridge. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the HomeKit Authentication service, which listens on TCP port 8080 by default. Crafted data in a pairing request can cause the device to allow authentication using a blank password. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to bypass authentication on the system. Was ZDI-CAN-28323.

llama.cpp MTMD Multimodal GGUF File Parsing Integer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of llama.cpp. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must open a malicious file.

The specific flaw exists within the parsing of audio multimodal projector GGUF files. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in an integer overflow before allocating a buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code in the context of the current process. Was ZDI-CAN-30980.

llama.cpp GGUF File Parsing Heap-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of llama.cpp. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file.

The specific flaw exists within the parsing of GGUF files. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a heap-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code in the context of the current process. Was ZDI-CAN-34558.

llama.cpp GGUF File Parsing Integer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. The upload filename validation strips backslash characters but does not subsequently check for forward slashes when a backslash is detected; by supplying a filename containing both characters an attacker writes outside the intended upload directory to any writable path. Converting crafted input from UCS-4 to IBM1390 or IBM1399 character encoding, in the GNU C Library version 2.3.3 and later may result in the converter reading past the end of the input buffer, causing the calling application to crash.

When converting from UCS-4, these encoders may encounter a combining base such as U+00E6 and jump ahead by 4 bytes to check the next UCS-4 code point.  The check for end of buffer however does not account for this, which may result in a buffer overread if the following code point has less than 4 bytes remaining.  Exploitation of this bug not only requires attacker control of input and encoding, but also strict control over layout of the input in memory.

mail-parser is a tool that parses emails by enhancing the Python standard library and extracting message details into a comprehensive object. From 4.2.0 until 4.6.1, attacker-controlled email headers can cause polynomial regular-expression backtracking during ordinary parse_from_string(), parse_from_bytes(), or parse_from_file() calls. In src/mailparser/utils.py, get_addresses() invokes the _ADDR_FALLBACK_RE fallback when strict address parsing yields no usable address, and overlapping quantifiers rescan padded address headers quadratically or cubically. In src/mailparser/const.py, parse_received() applies _CLAUSE_SPLITTER to uncollapsed whitespace in a Received header, causing quadratic backtracking when a whitespace run is not followed by a clause keyword. A small, well-formed message can keep mail gateway, ticketing, quarantine, or archival parsing workers busy for extended periods. This issue is fixed in version 4.6.1.

mail-parser is a tool that parses emails by enhancing the Python standard library and extracting message details into a comprehensive object. From 3.7.0 until 4.6.3, receiveds_format() in src/mailparser/utils.py catches only TypeError and ValueError while converting the trailing date of an attacker-controlled Received header. An out-of-range year can cause calendar.timegm() to raise OverflowError, and a sufficiently large timezone offset can cause datetime.fromtimestamp() to raise OSError. These exceptions are outside the MailParserError hierarchy, so one crafted header can abort the entire message parse through every parse_from_* entry point and may drop a queued batch. This issue is fixed in version 4.6.3.

eml_parser serves as a python module for parsing eml files and returning various information found in the e-mail as well as computed information. In 3.0.3 and earlier, eml_parser.routing.parserouting() in eml_parser/routing.py builds a regular expression with multiple greedy capture groups and appends the npdate date literal extracted from a normalized copy of an attacker-controlled Received header, then searches that expression against the original unnormalized line. A formatting difference can make the trailing literal impossible to match, causing exhaustive backtracking across the greedy groups at each start position. The unsliced Received-header path is invoked by decode_email, decode_email_bytes, and parse_email, so one small unauthenticated message can pin a parser worker and create sustained queue backlog. This issue is fixed in version 3.0.4.

Phoenix is an AI observability and evaluation platform. From 13.0.0 until 15.7.0, the applyChatTemplate GraphQL query passed attacker-controlled F-string templates to FStringTemplateFormatter._format, while DotDict.__getattr__ did not prevent traversal through Python private attributes. A crafted field could traverse object internals such as __class__, __init__, and __globals__ to read process environment variables and internal module state. The endpoint is unauthenticated on default installations, and any account can reach it when authentication is enabled. Exposure of PHOENIX_SECRET can allow administrative session-token forgery and decryption of credentials protected by keys derived from that secret. This issue is fixed in version 15.7.0.

Phison E12 and E18 PCIe SSD controllers contain a Secure Boot bypass vulnerability that allows a privileged local attacker to inject persistent boot-patch tuples into the unsigned, CRC-protected flash ID page read by the BootROM. By overwriting a fuse-derived RAM variable via a crafted patch entry using Phison Vendor Specific Commands, an attacker can force CRC-only firmware verification instead of signature checking, enabling an unsigned firmware image to load and creating a persistent controller-level implant that survives firmware reinstallation and operates below the host operating system.

OpenCTI is an open source platform for managing cyber threat intelligence knowledge and observables. Prior to 7.260416.0, public TAXII 2.1 collections configured with taxii_public set to true are served under the high-privilege SYSTEM_USER context rather than a restricted public-sharing user context. Unauthenticated requests can therefore bypass object markings, organization segregation, and authorized_members restrictions and retrieve restricted threat-intelligence objects that match the collection filters; a broad or absent filter can expose most of the database. Version 7.260416.0 remediates this issue for new configurations, but public-sharing configurations created before that version are not covered and are tracked separately in GHSA-25r9-q6rp-j7jw.

Converting crafted ISO-2022-CN-EXT input to UTF-8 character encoding, in the GNU C Library version 2.2 through 2.44 may result in the converter reading past the end of the input buffer, causing the calling application to crash.

When the ISO-2022-CN-EXT decoder encounters an invalid input byte sequence like '\x0e' it ends up advancing the pointer tracking the read buffer position twice.  If this sequence is at the end of the input buffer, the decoder may then end up reading past the bounds of the input buffer.  To exploit this, the input and encoding needs to be attacker controlled.

matrix-hookshot is a Matrix bot for connecting to external services like GitHub, GitLab, JIRA, and more. Prior to 7.3.3, Hookshot can crash in src/Bridge.ts while processing a modern Matrix reply whose m.relates_to.m.in_reply_to.event_id identifies an event that the bot cannot read. Bridge event handling calls botClient.getEvent() for the parent event without catching the resulting M_NOT_FOUND error, allowing the rejected request to escape reply processing and terminate the service. This issue is fixed in version 7.3.3.

ESP-IDF is the Espressif Internet of Things (IoT) Development Framework. Prior to 5.2.8, 5.3.6, 5.5.6, and 6.0.3, the Bluedroid BLE Mesh GATT server read handler bt_mesh_bta_gatts_cb in esp_ble_mesh stores a signed attribute-read callback length in an unsigned 16-bit variable. A negative ATT error code is therefore interpreted as a very large successful length and used for a memory copy from a small stack buffer into the GATT response structure. A remote attacker within Bluetooth LE range who can connect to an exposed PB-GATT provisioning or Mesh Proxy service can trigger a failed attribute read with a crafted request. On devices where the affected attributes are accessible without pairing, exploitation requires neither pairing nor user interaction; access requirements depend on device configuration. The resulting out-of-bounds read and stack-based buffer overflow corrupts the Bluetooth host task stack, causing a crash and device restart and potentially further memory corruption. The issue affects devices built with CONFIG_BT_BLUEDROID_ENABLED=y and BLE Mesh GATT enabled; the NimBLE host path is not affected. This issue is fixed in versions 5.2.8, 5.3.6, 5.5.6, and 6.0.3.

Kadence Security plugin for WordPress (better-wp-security) before 10.0.6.1 contains a brute-force protection bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to evade per-host login lockouts by exploiting IPv6 address handling in ITSEC_Lib::get_ip(), which keys failed-login counters on the full 128-bit IPv6 address rather than a /64 prefix. Attackers who control a routed IPv6 /64 can send each login attempt from a new address within that prefix, resetting the per-host counter each time to perform password spraying and username enumeration, and can similarly evade the auto_ban_admin immediate ban via address rotation.
vp: kadence security – password, two factor authentication, and brute force protection

cves.d: Mistune is a Python Markdown parser with renderers and plugins. Prior to 3.3.4, inline image parsing sends nested ![ openers through precedence_scan because the no_link_before and _label_contains_link linearization guards are gated by not is_image. In src/mistune/inline_parser.py, each outer image opener can therefore search the remaining image body, while max_image_depth does not apply because the failed scans do not produce image tokens. Rendering untrusted Markdown with the default HTML renderer and no plugins can perform quadratic CPU work and keep a worker at 100 percent utilization. This issue is fixed in version 3.3.4.

Kiwi TCMS is an open source test management system. From 16.1 until 16.2, the account confirmation page’s incomplete validation of the next parameter accepts protocol-relative URLs because the version 16.1 fix for CVE-2026-54724 only requires the value to start with a slash. An unauthenticated attacker can craft a confirmation URL on a trusted Kiwi TCMS hostname that redirects a user to an external site, enabling phishing and related downstream confidentiality or integrity impacts when the user follows the link. This issue is fixed in version 16.2.

FreeSWITCH is a Software Defined Telecom Stack enabling the digital transformation from proprietary telecom switches to a software implementation that runs on any commodity hardware. In 1.11.2 and earlier, rtp_common_read() in src/switch_rtp.c uses one session-wide autoadj_tally to learn RTP sources that differ from the address negotiated in SDP. An unauthenticated remote attacker who sends plaintext RTP during call setup can make packets from one or more non-advertised sources reach the threshold before the legitimate endpoint, causing FreeSWITCH to adopt the source of the threshold-crossing packet as the media peer. The attacker can then receive call audio, inject media, and deny media to the legitimate endpoint without being on the media path. FreeSWITCH 1.11.2 adds two opt-in controls, but both default to zero and the release remains affected unless both are configured before RTP session creation. This vulnerability is fixed in 1.11.2.

Missing Authorization vulnerability in Cozmoslabs Paid Member Subscriptions paid-member-subscriptions allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Paid Member Subscriptions: from n/a through 3.1.4.

Dell SupportAssist OS Recovery, versions prior to 5.5.16.3, contain a Missing Authorization vulnerability. A low privileged attacker with local access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to Unauthorized access.

Dell SupportAssist OS Recovery, versions prior to 5.5.16.3, contain an Insecure Inherited Permissions vulnerability. A low privileged attacker with local access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to unauthorized file operations with elevated privileges.

tac_plus-ng before commit d8493e0 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows clients holding the TACACS+ shared key to overflow a stack buffer due to an operator precedence error in author_pak_looks_bogus() and accounting_pak_looks_bogus(). Attackers can send packets whose argument-length table exceeds the payload, causing eval_args() to read past the packet and memcpy() oversized cmd values into cmdline, crashing the daemon or executing code.

linkdotnet Blog through 17.1 contains an open redirect vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to redirect users by passing unvalidated redirectUri values on the Login and Logout pages. Attackers can craft login links sending victims to attacker-controlled sites after authentication, and inject persistent returnTo destinations into other users' logout redirects via the shared AuthInformation instance.

GreaterWMS through 2.1.54 contains an unauthenticated path traversal vulnerability in the css, js, statics and fonts routes in greaterwms/views.py, which concatenate raw request.path_info without normalization. Attackers can send URL-encoded ../ sequences to read db.sqlite3 and obtain user openid tokens, enabling impersonation of any account.

ArtisanCloud PowerX through 1.0.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the IAM role management API that allows authenticated tenant members to escalate privileges. Attackers holding even the lowest built-in role can call the permissions/grant-ids, permissions/grant, or bind/member routes to grant permissions or bind privileged roles, gaining tenant administrative access.

Habitat through 1.7.1 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in CreatePostController::addAttachmentsToPost() that allows authenticated users to claim other users' unposted image uploads. Email-verified attackers can submit sequential attachmentIds when creating a post to attach another user's pending image, exposing it publicly and removing it from the uploader's post.

fzf is a command-line fuzzy finder. Prior to 0.74.5, bin/fzf-tmux validates separately supplied layout sizes but does not validate attached -l and -u layout values before Bash arithmetic expansion, allowing command substitution in a crafted operand to execute as the invoking user during option parsing. The same validation failure lets space-bearing popup geometry options -x, -y, -w, -h, and -p reach an unquoted tmux popup option string and inject additional tmux flags. Exploitation requires less-trusted project configuration, a wrapper, or a plugin to supply the poisoned value and requires the victim to invoke fzf-tmux; normal values are usually trusted, and the script has been superseded by built-in tmux options. This issue is fixed in version 0.74.5.

Bonsai through 6.0 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated Editor users to access admin pages because AdminAuthHandler accepts both Administrator and Editor roles. Attackers can use UsersController and DynamicConfigController to reset administrator passwords, promote accounts to Administrator, and change global settings to take over the instance.

Converting crafted CP949 input to UTF-8 character encoding and ignoring invalid characters, in the GNU C Library version 2.1 or later may result in the converter reading past the end of the input buffer, causing the calling application to crash.

When the CP949 decoder encounters an invalid input byte sequence like '\xa2\xe8' it ends up advancing the pointer tracking the read buffer position twice.  If //IGNORE is set on the destination encoding and this sequence is at the end of the input buffer, the decoder may then end up reading past the bounds of the input buffer.  To exploit this, the target iconv function needs to set //IGNORE on the destination of the conversion and the input and encoding needs to be attacker controlled.

wishthis through 1.2.3 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in User::ownsWishlist() that allows authenticated users to modify other users' wishes and wishlists. Attackers can supply sequential wish_id and wishlist_id values to the wishes and wishlists API handlers to edit wishes, add wishes, or rename and delete wishlists.

Dolibarr ERP CRM before 24.0.2 contains an improper authorization vulnerability in the Users REST API put() method that allows non-admin API users to set administrator passwords. Authenticated users with user modification and password rights can send a PUT request to the users endpoint with a chosen pass value for a SuperAdmin account and then log in as that administrator.

HyperFrames before 0.9.30 contains a missing Origin and Host validation vulnerability in the unauthenticated Studio API that allows malicious web pages to write project files. Attackers can send CORS-simple POST requests to /api/projects/:id/files/* or use DNS rebinding to plant package.json scripts or agent configs, leading to command execution.

Missing Authorization vulnerability in Cozmoslabs Paid Member Subscriptions paid-member-subscriptions allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Paid Member Subscriptions: from n/a through 3.1.4.

ModelScope 1.11.0 to before 1.40.1 contains an unsafe reflection vulnerability in the image-to-3D SyncDreamer pipeline that allows remote attackers to execute code via crafted model configuration. Attackers can publish a model whose syncdreamer.yaml target field makes instantiate_from_config() import and instantiate any class with controlled params, without an allowlist or trust_remote_code check, executing code when victims load it.

Storyden before 1.26.17 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the AccountRemoveRole handler that allows non-administrator users with MANAGE_ROLES to remove administrator roles. Attackers can send DELETE requests to the account roles endpoint to demote other administrators, potentially leaving the instance with no administrator.

Frappe HR (hrms) before 16.9.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the hrms.api.roster.get_events method that allows authenticated employees to view other employees' leave and shift data by bypassing User Permissions. Attackers with the Employee role can call get_events with empty filters for any date range to retrieve every employee's approved leave applications and shift assignments, including leave types, dates, shift locations and times.

Pi-hole FTL is the core engine of the Pi-hole network-level advertisement and tracker blocker. From 6.0 until 6.7, validation in src/api/list.c permits spaces for GRAVITY_GROUPS and consequently skips carriage-return and line-feed validation for group names submitted through POST /api/groups. The unsanitized name is copied into the Location value in pi_hole_extra_headers, and CivetWeb interprets embedded CR/LF sequences as separate HTTP response headers. An authenticated administrator can therefore inject headers such as Set-Cookie, Location, or Cache-Control; when a browser processes the response, this can cause session fixation, attacker-controlled redirects, or cache behavior changes. This issue is fixed in version 6.7.

Pi-hole FTL is the core engine of the Pi-hole network-level advertisement and tracker blocker. Prior to 6.7, log_http_access in src/webserver/webserver.c writes attacker-controlled User-Agent content to the access log without output neutralization when debug.api is enabled. If an administrator configures files.log.webserver inside webserver.paths.webroot with a filename matching lua_server_page_pattern, an unauthenticated request can plant Lua markup in that log and a later request can cause CivetWeb to evaluate the log as a Lua server page. The resulting commands run as the pihole operating-system user and can access or modify pihole-owned configuration, credentials, databases, logs, and rendered interface content. When the log is not served through the Lua handler, the same unneutralized writer still permits log forgery and downstream log-parser injection. This issue is fixed in version 6.7.

Atomic Server is an open source headless CMS and real-time database. From 0.29.0 to 0.40.2, Atomic Server provisions a well-known /setup invite with write enabled, the Drive root as its target, and usagesLeft set to one. construct_invite_redirect in server/src/plugins/invite.rs discards the redeemer identity, so an unauthenticated request containing an attacker-controlled public-key can create a new Agent and grant it write access to the entire Drive. On a fresh, unclaimed deployment, this permits reading, modifying, or deleting resources, changing permissions, and creating or altering Agents. No complete fixed version was verified as of this review.

Servo is a lightweight, high-performance web rendering engine for embedding web technologies in applications. Prior to 0.4.0, a frame with sandbox="" can reach and execute a javascript: URL through declarative refresh because RefreshRedirectDue::invoke() in components/script/dom/document/document.rs can reach JavaScript URL handling in components/script/script_thread.rs without enforcing the sandbox's script prohibition. This gives attacker-controlled content arbitrary JavaScript execution in a frame intended to be scriptless, including nested DOM probe creation and blind browser requests. The frame retains an opaque origin, so the issue does not by itself provide parent DOM access. This issue is fixed in version 0.4.0.
Information leak in Enterprise in Google Chrome prior to 158.0.8127.36 allowed a remote attacker to leak sensitive information via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: Low)

Typecho before 1.3.1-rc contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the XML-RPC pingback.ping method where checkSafeHost() validates a hostname's resolved IP once but the subsequent outbound request performs an independent DNS resolution, creating a TOCTOU window exploitable via DNS rebinding. An unauthenticated attacker can configure a domain to return a benign IP at validation time and an internal address (loopback, RFC1918, or cloud metadata IP) at request time, causing the server to issue blind SSRF requests to arbitrary internal hosts and ports.

WeGIA is a web manager for charitable institutions. Prior to 3.9.1, web/controle/control.php authorizes FuncionarioControle requests only by checking whether an authenticated employee has a permission row for resource 11 or 91, while MiddlewareDAO::verificarPermissao() does not compare the stored id_acao value or authorize the requested method. An employee with any such permission and a valid CSRF token from the employee's own session can invoke FuncionarioControle::adicionarPermissao, FuncionarioControle::alterarPermissao, or FuncionarioControle::excluirPermissao to add, change, or remove permissions for arbitrary roles. This can grant higher action levels over sensitive resources, expose or modify protected employee, patient, configuration, and administrative data, or disrupt legitimate access by changing other roles. This issue is fixed in version 3.9.1.

An unauthenticated remote requester who supplies a target member identifier and replacement member fields can modify arbitrary member records, corrupt personal information, and cause loss of data integrity. Improper Neutralization of Null Byte or NUL Character vulnerability in the AdoNetAppender of Apache log4net.

Text parameters were bound unchanged, so a NUL character or an unpaired UTF-16 surrogate reached the database as it was. A database that refuses such a value, such as PostgreSQL, rejected the insert and the event was lost; only the first such loss per appender was reported. A party whose data reaches a log message could suppress that event.

This issue affects Apache log4net: from 1.2.9 before 3.6.0.

Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.6.0, which fixes the issue.

Missing Authorization vulnerability in Cozmoslabs Paid Member Subscriptions paid-member-subscriptions allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Paid Member Subscriptions: from n/a through 3.1.4.

Improper Output Neutralization for Logs vulnerability in the FileAppender, RollingFileAppender, UdpAppender and SmtpAppender of Apache log4net.

Characters the configured encoding could not represent were converted by that encoding's best-fit fallback, which turns fullwidth characters such as U+FF1C, U+FF1E and U+FF02 into <, > and ". The conversion happened after XmlLayout or XmlLayoutSchemaLog4J had escaped the text, so a party whose data reaches a log message could forge complete log events in an XML log, for example a fake audit entry. On .NET Framework this needs no configuration where the ANSI code page is single-byte, since that is the default encoding; on .NET it needs a configured single-byte encoding such as ISO-8859-1. This is the best-fit conversion described by the WorstFit research.

This issue affects Apache log4net: from 1.2.9 before 3.6.0.

Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.6.0, which fixes the issue.

Improper Neutralization of Script-Related HTML Tags in a Web Page (Basic XSS) vulnerability in Cozmoslabs Paid Member Subscriptions paid-member-subscriptions allows Code Injection.This issue affects Paid Member Subscriptions: from n/a through 3.1.4.

Improper Output Neutralization for Logs vulnerability in the XmlLayout and XmlLayoutSchemaLog4J of Apache log4net.

Both layouts split a message holding the CDATA end marker into several CDATA sections, but searched for the marker with a culture-sensitive comparison. Ignorable characters or a combining mark around the marker made the search miss it, so the CDATA section stayed open. From 3.3.1 on, an XML parser then reads the following log events as part of that message; earlier versions leave the log file not well-formed. A party whose data reaches a log message could hide later log events from a consumer that parses the XML log.

This issue affects Apache log4net: from 1.2.9 before 3.6.0.

Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.6.0, which fixes the issue.

Use after free in Proxy in Google Chrome prior to 158.0.8127.36 allowed a remote attacker who had compromised the renderer process to execute arbitrary code outside the sandbox via a crafted file. (Chromium security severity: Medium)

Vulnerability in the Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition product of Oracle Java SE (component: Compiler).  Supported versions that are affected are Oracle Java SE: 8u511b33-perf, 17.0.21.0.3, 21.0.13.0.3, 25.0.5.0.3, 27.0.1.0.3; Oracle GraalVM for JDK: 17.0.21.0.3 and  21.0.13.0.3; Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition: 21.3.20.0.3. Difficult to exploit vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with network access via multiple protocols to compromise Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition.  Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in takeover of Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition. Note: This vulnerability can only be exploited by supplying data to APIs in the specified Component without using Untrusted Java Web Start applications or Untrusted Java applets, such as through a web service. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 8.1 (Confidentiality, Integrity and Availability impacts).  CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H).

Vasion Print (formerly PrinterLogic) Virtual Appliance Host and Application (VA/SaaS deployments) contain an undocumented 'printerlogic' user with a hardcoded SSH public key in '~/.ssh/authorized_keys' and a sudoers rule granting the printerlogic_ssh group 'NOPASSWD: ALL'. Possession of the matching private key gives an attacker root access to the appliance.

Vasion Print (formerly PrinterLogic) Virtual Appliance Host and Application (VA/SaaS deployments) store a large number of sensitive credentials (database passwords, MySQL root password, SaaS keys, Portainer admin password, etc.) in cleartext files that are world-readable. Any local user - or any process that can read the host filesystem - can retrieve all of these secrets in plain text, leading to credential theft and full compromise of the appliance. The vendor does not consider this to be a security vulnerability as this product "follows a shared responsibility model, where administrators are expected to configure persistent storage encryption."

Vasion Print (formerly PrinterLogic) Virtual Appliance Host and Application (VA/SaaS deployments) store user passwords using unsalted SHA-512 hashes with a fall-back to unsalted SHA-1. The hashing is performed via PHP's `hash()` function in multiple files (server_write_requests_users.php, update_database.php, legacy/Login.php, tests/Unit/Api/IdpControllerTest.php). No per-user salt is used and the fast hash algorithms are unsuitable for password storage. An attacker who obtains the password database can recover cleartext passwords via offline dictionary or rainbow table attacks. The vulnerable code also contains logic that migrates legacy SHA-1 hashes to SHA-512 on login, further exposing users still on the old hash. This vulnerability was partially resolved, but still present within the legacy authentication platform.

Vasion Print (formerly PrinterLogic) Virtual Appliance Host and Application (VA and SaaS deployments) mount host configuration and secret material under /var/www/efs_storage into many Docker containers with overly-permissive filesystem permissions. Files such as secrets.env, GPG-encrypted blobs in .secrets, MySQL client keys, and application session files are accessible from multiple containers. An attacker who controls or reaches any container can read or modify these artifacts, leading to credential theft, RCE via Laravel APP_KEY, Portainer takeover, and full compromise.

Vasion Print (formerly PrinterLogic) Virtual Appliance Host and Application (VA and SaaS deployments) contains multiple Docker containers that run primary application processes (for example PHP workers, Node.js servers and custom binaries) as the root user. This increases the blast radius of a container compromise and enables lateral movement and host compromise when a container is breached.

Vasion Print (formerly PrinterLogic) Virtual Appliance Host and Application (VA and SaaS deployments) run many Docker containers on shared internal networks without firewalling or segmentation between instances. A compromise of any single container allows direct access to internal services (HTTP, Redis, MySQL, etc.) on the overlay network. From a compromised container, an attacker can reach and exploit other services, enabling lateral movement, data theft, and system-wide compromise.

Vasion Print (formerly PrinterLogic) Virtual Appliance Host and Application (VA and SaaS deployments)  provision the appliance with the network account credentials in clear-text inside /etc/issue, and the file is world-readable by default. An attacker with local shell access can read /etc/issue to obtain the network account username and password. Using the network account an attacker can change network parameters via the appliance interface, enabling local misconfiguration, network disruption or further escalation depending on deployment.

An unauthenticated OS command injection vulnerability exists in the Shenzhen Aitemi M300 Wi-Fi Repeater (hardware model MT02) via the 'time' parameter of the '/protocol.csp?' endpoint. The input is processed by the internal date '-s' command without rebooting or disrupting HTTP service. Unlike other injection points, this vector allows remote compromise without triggering visible configuration changes.

cves.d: A client-side security misconfiguration vulnerability exists in OpenBlow whistleblowing platform across multiple versions and default deployments, due to the absence of critical HTTP response headers including Content-Security-Policy, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy, and Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy. This omission weakens browser-level defenses and exposes users to cross-site scripting (XSS), clickjacking, and referer leakage. Although some instances attempt to enforce CSP via HTML <meta> tags, this method is ineffective, as modern browsers rely on header-based enforcement to reliably block inline scripts and untrusted resources.

Inspur Haiyue HCM Cloud contains an arbitrary file read vulnerability in the /api/model_report/file/download endpoint that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to read arbitrary files by supplying unvalidated path parameters index and ext. Attackers can craft requests such as /api/model_report/file/download?index=/&ext=<path> to traverse the filesystem and disclose sensitive files including /etc/passwd, application database files, and system configuration files. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2024-11-04 .

Landray OA contains an unauthenticated HQL injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to query arbitrary Hibernate entity classes by injecting malicious HQL syntax into the uid POST parameter of the wechatLoginHelper.do endpoint. Attackers can exploit the lack of input sanitization in the string-concatenated filter expression passed to the Hibernate findList() call to extract sensitive data such as administrator password hashes and, with sufficient database privileges, perform file-write operations enabling remote code execution. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2024-03-11 (UTC).

Redsea Cloud eHR contains an arbitrary file upload vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution by uploading malicious files through the PtFjk.mob servlet endpoint. Attackers can submit a multipart POST request with a JSP webshell disguised using a spoofed image/jpeg Content-Type to bypass the absence of extension and MIME type validation, with the uploaded file stored at a predictable path under the uploadfile directory and executed directly by the web server. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2024-11-03 (UTC).
vendors: guangzhou red sea cloud computing co., ltd.
vp: guangzhou red sea cloud computing co., ltd.

cves.d: Huijietong Cloud Video Platform contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker can supply arbitrary file paths to the `fullPath` parameter of the `/fileDownload?action=downloadBackupFile` endpoint and retrieve files from the server filesystem. VulnCheck has observed this vulnerability being exploited in the wild.

MicroWorld eScan AV's update mechanism failed to ensure authenticity and integrity of updates: update packages were delivered and accepted without robust cryptographic verification. As a result, an on-path attacker could perform a man-in-the-middle (MitM) attack and substitute malicious update payloads for legitimate ones. The eScan AV client accepted these substituted packages and executed or loaded their components (including sideloaded DLLs and Java/installer payloads), enabling remote code execution on affected systems. MicroWorld eScan confirmed remediation of the update mechanism on 2023-07-31 but versioning details are unavailable. NOTE: MicroWorld eScan disputes the characterization in third-party reports, stating the issue relates to 2018–2019 and that controls were implemented then.

SPON IP Network Broadcast System, a digital audio transmission platform developed by SPON Communications, contains an arbitrary file read vulnerability in the rj_get_token.php endpoint. The flaw arises from insufficient input validation on the jsondata[url] parameter, which allows attackers to perform directory traversal and access sensitive files on the server. An unauthenticated remote attacker can exploit this vulnerability by sending a crafted POST request to read arbitrary files, potentially exposing system configuration, credentials, or internal logic. An affected version range is undefined.
vendors: changsha spon communication technology co. ltd.
vp: changsha spon communication technology co. ltd.

cves.d: A SQL injection vulnerability exists in the St. Joe ERP system ("圣乔ERP系统") that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary SQL commands via crafted HTTP POST requests to the login endpoint. The application fails to properly sanitize user-supplied input before incorporating it into SQL queries, enabling direct manipulation of the backend database. Successful exploitation may result in unauthorized data access, modification of records, or limited disruption of service. An affected version range is undefined. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2025-04-14 UTC.
vp: st. joe erp system ("圣乔erp系统")

cves.d: BYTEVALUE Intelligent Flow Control Router contains a command injection vulnerability via the /goform/webRead/open endpoint. The `path` parameter is not properly validated and is echoed into a shell context, allowing an attacker to inject and execute arbitrary shell commands on the device. Successful exploitation can lead to writing backdoors, privilege escalation on the host, and full compromise of the router and its management functions. VulnCheck has observed this vulnerability being targeted by the RondoDox botnet campaign.
vendors: bytevalue (luoyang baiwei intelligent technology co., ltd.)
vp: bytevalue (luoyang baiwei intelligent technology co., ltd.)

cves.d: SecGate3600, a network firewall product developed by NSFOCUS, contains a sensitive information disclosure vulnerability in the /cgi-bin/authUser/authManageSet.cgi endpoint. The affected component fails to enforce authentication checks on POST requests to retrieve user data. An unauthenticated remote attacker can exploit this flaw to obtain sensitive information, including user identifiers and configuration details, by sending crafted requests to the vulnerable endpoint. An affected version range is undefined. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2024-06-18 UTC.

Sangfor Behavior Management System (also referred to as DC Management System in Chinese-language documentation) contains an XML external entity (XXE) injection vulnerability in the /src/sangforindex endpoint. A remote unauthenticated attacker can submit crafted XML data containing external entity definitions, leading to potential disclosure of internal files, server-side request forgery (SSRF), or other impacts depending on parser behavior. The vulnerability is due to improper configuration of the XML parser, which allows resolution of external entities without restriction. This product is now integrated into their IAM (Internet Access Management) platform and an affected version range is undefined. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-09-06 UTC.
vp: sangfor behavior management system (dc management system)

cves.d: Ruijie RG-UAC Application Management Gateway contains a command injection vulnerability via the 'nmc_sync.php' interface. An unauthenticated attacker able to reach the affected endpoint can inject shell commands via crafted request data, causing the application to execute arbitrary commands on the host. Successful exploitation can yield full control of the application process and may lead to system-level access depending on the service privileges. VulnCheck has observed this vulnerability being targeted by the RondoDox botnet campaign.

H3C CVM, the Cloud Virtualization Management component of the H3C CAS cloud platform, contains an unauthenticated arbitrary file upload vulnerability in the /cas/fileUpload/upload endpoint that allows remote attackers to write arbitrary files by manipulating the caller-supplied token parameter without restricting path traversal or file type. Attackers can exploit the path traversal in the token parameter to upload a malicious JSP file into a web-accessible directory and then request it to achieve remote code execution as the web-server user. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-14.

iDocView contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in its /doc/upload endpoint that allows remote unauthenticated attackers to fetch arbitrary URLs by supplying a hardcoded default token value (testtoken) to bypass authentication. Attackers can exploit the unrestricted URL scheme handling, including file:// URIs, to read arbitrary local files such as operating-system and application configuration files, and to reach internal network hosts and services not otherwise accessible. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2024-03-26.

Fumasoft Fumeng Cloud contains a SQL injection vulnerability in the AjaxMethod.ashx endpoint that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to inject arbitrary SQL through the Name parameter of the getEmpByname action without any authentication. Attackers can exploit UNION-based SQL injection techniques against the Microsoft SQL Server backend to extract, disclose, and modify database contents, with potential for further compromise of the underlying server. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-18.

A cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Sitecore Experience Platform (XP) 7.5 - 10.2 and CMS 7.2 - 7.2 Update-6 that may allow authenticated Sitecore Shell users to be tricked into executing custom JS code. Managed Cloud Standard customers who run the affected Sitecore Experience Platform / CMS versions are also affected.

Chanjet CRM contains an unauthenticated SQL injection vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary SQL queries by manipulating the site_id GET parameter in the webservice endpoint. Attackers can exploit the lack of input sanitization or parameterization through UNION-based injection techniques to extract sensitive data from the underlying database. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-18.

COMMAX Smart Home System is a smart IoT home solution that allows an unauthenticated attacker to disclose RTSP credentials in plain-text by exploiting the /overview.asp endpoint. Attackers can access sensitive information, including login credentials and DVR settings, by submitting a GET request to this endpoint.
vp: smart home ruvie cctv bridge dvr service

cves.d: COMMAX Smart Home System allows an unauthenticated attacker to change configuration and cause denial-of-service through the setconf endpoint. Attackers can trigger a denial-of-service scenario by sending a malformed request to the setconf endpoint.
vp: smart home ruvie cctv bridge dvr service

cves.d: Weaver e-Bridge contains an unauthenticated arbitrary file read vulnerability that allows remote attackers to access arbitrary files on the host system by supplying a file: URL to the downloadUrl parameter of the saveYZJFile endpoint. Attackers can exploit this flaw to read sensitive files such as /etc/passwd or configuration and credential files, and the same endpoint's support for http(s) URLs also enables server-side request forgery against internal network resources. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-17.

Weaver E-cology contains an unauthenticated SQL injection vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary SQL queries by submitting malicious input through the userIdentifiers GET parameter in the mobile plugin endpoint. Attackers can bypass space-based filter controls by wrapping SQL keywords in parentheses to perform UNION-based injection and extract sensitive data including administrator credential hashes from the database. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2022-07-28.

Bootstrapy CMS contains multiple SQL injection vulnerabilities that allow unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary SQL queries by injecting malicious code through POST parameters. Attackers can inject SQL payloads into the thread_id parameter of forum-thread.php, the subject parameter of contact-submit.php, the post-id parameter of post-new-submit.php, and the thread-id parameter to extract sensitive database information or cause denial of service.

Netartmedia Vlog System contains an SQL injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to manipulate database queries by injecting SQL code through the email parameter. Attackers can send POST requests to index.php with malicious email values in the forgotten_password module to extract sensitive database information.

Inout Article Base CMS contains SQL injection vulnerabilities that allow unauthenticated attackers to manipulate database queries through the 'p' and 'u' parameters. Attackers can inject SQL code using XOR-based payloads in GET requests to portalLogin.php to extract sensitive database information or cause denial of service through time-based attacks.

Meeplace Business Review Script contains an SQL injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary SQL queries by injecting malicious code through the 'id' parameter. Attackers can send GET requests to the addclick.php endpoint with crafted SQL payloads in the 'id' parameter to extract sensitive database information or cause denial of service.

Zeeways Jobsite CMS contains an SQL injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to manipulate database queries by injecting SQL code through the 'id' GET parameter. Attackers can send crafted requests to news_details.php, jobs_details.php, or job_cmp_details.php with malicious 'id' values using GROUP BY and CASE statements to extract sensitive database information.

Zeeways Matrimony CMS contains multiple SQL injection vulnerabilities that allow unauthenticated attackers to manipulate database queries through the profile_list endpoint. Attackers can inject SQL code via the up_cast, s_mother, and s_religion parameters to extract sensitive database information using time-based or error-based techniques.

MiniFtp contains a buffer overflow vulnerability in the parseconf_load_setting function that allows local attackers to execute arbitrary code by supplying oversized configuration values. Attackers can craft a miniftpd.conf file with values exceeding 128 bytes to overflow stack buffers and overwrite the return address, enabling code execution with root privileges.

Netartmedia PHP Dating Site contains a SQL injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to manipulate database queries by injecting SQL code through the Email parameter. Attackers can send POST requests to loginaction.php with time-based SQL injection payloads in the Email field to extract sensitive database information.

Netartmedia PHP Car Dealer contains an SQL injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary SQL queries by injecting malicious code through the features[] parameter. Attackers can submit POST requests to index.php with crafted SQL payloads in the features[] parameter to extract sensitive database information or manipulate database queries.

Netartmedia Deals Portal contains an SQL injection vulnerability in the Email parameter of loginaction.php that allows unauthenticated attackers to manipulate database queries. Attackers can submit crafted SQL payloads through POST requests to extract sensitive information or bypass authentication mechanisms.

uHotelBooking System contains an SQL injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to manipulate database queries by injecting SQL code through the system_page GET parameter. Attackers can send crafted requests to index.php with malicious system_page values using time-based blind SQL injection techniques to extract sensitive database information.

XooGallery Latest contains an SQL injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to manipulate database queries by injecting SQL code through the 'p' parameter. Attackers can send GET requests to results.php with malicious 'p' values to bypass authentication, extract sensitive data, or modify database contents.

XooGallery Latest contains an SQL injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to manipulate database queries by injecting SQL code through the cat_id parameter. Attackers can send GET requests to cat.php with malicious cat_id values to bypass authentication, extract sensitive data, or modify database contents.

XooGallery Latest contains multiple SQL injection vulnerabilities that allow unauthenticated attackers to manipulate database queries by injecting SQL code through the photo_id parameter. Attackers can send GET requests to photo.php with malicious photo_id values to extract sensitive data, bypass authentication, or modify database contents.

XooGallery Latest contains an SQL injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to manipulate database queries by injecting SQL code through the gal_id parameter. Attackers can send GET requests to gal.php with malicious gal_id values to extract sensitive database information or modify database contents.

XooDigital Latest contains an SQL injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to manipulate database queries by injecting SQL code through the 'p' parameter. Attackers can send GET requests to results.php with malicious 'p' values to extract sensitive database information.

NCrypted Jobgator contains an SQL injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to manipulate database queries by injecting SQL code through the experience parameter. Attackers can send POST requests to the agents Find-Jobs endpoint with malicious experience values to extract sensitive database information.

iScripts ReserveLogic contains an SQL injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to manipulate database queries by injecting SQL code through the jqSearchDestination parameter. Attackers can send POST requests to the search endpoint with crafted SQL payloads to extract sensitive database information.

ARMBot contains an unrestricted file upload vulnerability in upload.php that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload arbitrary files by manipulating the file parameter with path traversal sequences. Attackers can upload PHP files with traversal payloads ../public_html/ to write executable code to the web root and achieve remote code execution.

Inout RealEstate contains an SQL injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to manipulate database queries by injecting SQL code through the city parameter. Attackers can send POST requests to the agents/agentlistdetails endpoint with malicious SQL payloads in the city parameter to extract sensitive database information.

Clinic Pro contains a SQL injection vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers to manipulate database queries by injecting SQL code through the month parameter. Attackers can send POST requests to the monthly_expense_overview endpoint with crafted month values using boolean-based blind, time-based blind, or error-based SQL injection techniques to extract sensitive database information.

IntelBras Telefone IP TIP200 and 200 LITE contain an unauthenticated arbitrary file read vulnerability in the dumpConfigFile function accessible via the cgiServer.exx endpoint. Attackers can send GET requests to /cgi-bin/cgiServer.exx with the command parameter containing dumpConfigFile() to read sensitive files including /etc/shadow and configuration files without proper authorization.

DIGIT CENTRIS ERP contains an SQL injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to manipulate database queries by injecting SQL code through the datum1, datum2, KID, and PID parameters. Attackers can send POST requests to /korisnikinfo.php with malicious SQL syntax in these parameters to extract or modify sensitive database information.

Inventory Webapp contains an SQL injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to manipulate database queries by injecting SQL code through GET parameters. Attackers can supply malicious SQL payloads in the name, description, quantity, or cat_id parameters to add-item.php to execute arbitrary database commands.

WebIncorp ERP contains an SQL injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to manipulate database queries by injecting SQL code through the prod_id parameter. Attackers can send GET requests to product_detail.php with malicious prod_id values to extract sensitive database information.

NoviSmart CMS contains an SQL injection vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary SQL queries by injecting malicious code through the Referer HTTP header field. Attackers can craft requests with time-based SQL injection payloads in the Referer header to extract sensitive database information or cause denial of service.

Ashop Shopping Cart Software contains a time-based blind SQL injection vulnerability that allows attackers to manipulate database queries through the blacklistitemid parameter. Attackers can send POST requests to the admin/bannedcustomers.php endpoint with crafted SQL payloads using SLEEP functions to extract sensitive database information.

microASP Portal+ CMS contains an SQL injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary SQL queries by injecting malicious code into the explode_tree parameter. Attackers can send crafted requests to pagina.phtml with SQL injection payloads using extractvalue and concat functions to extract sensitive database information like the current database name.

Epross AVCON6 systems management platform contains an object-graph navigation language (OGNL) injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary commands by injecting malicious OGNL expressions. Attackers can send crafted requests to the login.action endpoint with OGNL payloads in the redirect parameter to instantiate ProcessBuilder objects and execute system commands with root privileges.

Multiple D-Link DIR-series routers, including DIR-110, DIR-412, DIR-600, DIR-610, DIR-615, DIR-645, and DIR-815 firmware version 1.03, contain a vulnerability in the service.cgi endpoint that allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary system commands without authentication. The flaw stems from improper input handling in the EVENT=CHECKFW parameter, which is passed directly to the system shell without sanitization. A crafted HTTP POST request can inject commands that are executed with root privileges, resulting in full device compromise. These router models are no longer supported at the time of assignment and affected version ranges may vary. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2025-08-21 UTC.

Caucho Resin contains a path traversal vulnerability in the documentation webapp (resin-doc) that allows remote unauthenticated attackers to read arbitrary files by supplying a relative path through the inputFile request parameter of the jndi-appconfig tutorial servlet. Attackers can craft requests with directory traversal sequences to the servlet endpoint to read files outside the intended tutorial directory on the underlying system. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2021-12-10.

DBLTek GoIP devices (models GoIP 1, 4, 8, 16, and 32) contain an undocumented vendor backdoor in the Telnet administrative interface that allows remote authentication as an undocumented user via a proprietary challenge–response scheme which is fundamentally flawed. Because the challenge response can be computed from the challenge itself, a remote attacker can authenticate without knowledge of a secret and obtain a root shell on the device. This can lead to persistent remote code execution, full device compromise, and arbitrary control of the device and any managed services. The firmware used within these devices was updated in December 2016 to make this vulnerability more complex to exploit. However, it is unknown if DBLTek has taken steps to fully mitigate.

AVTECH devices that include the CloudSetup.cgi management endpoint are vulnerable to authenticated OS command injection. The `exefile` parameter in CloudSetup.cgi is passed to the underlying system command execution without proper validation or whitelisting. An authenticated attacker who can invoke this endpoint can supply crafted input to execute arbitrary system commands as root. Successful exploitation grants full control of the device, and - depending on deployment and whether the device stores credentials or has network reachability to internal systems - may enable credential theft, lateral movement, or data exfiltration. The archived SEARCH-LAB disclosure implies that this vulnerability was remediated in early 2017, but AVTECH has not defined an affected version range.
vp: ip camera, nvr, and dvr devices

cves.d: Seeyon A6 collaborative office automation platform contains an unauthenticated SQL injection vulnerability in the attach_ids parameter of the file attachment download endpoint that allows remote attackers to extract arbitrary database contents without prior authentication. Attackers can inject UNION-based SQL statements through the attach_ids request parameter in downloadAtt.jsp to retrieve sensitive information including credentials and system configuration data. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-17.

A stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability exists in Synactis PDF In-The-Box ActiveX control (PDF_IN_1.ocx), specifically the ConnectToSynactis method. When a long string is passed to this method—intended to populate the ldCmdLine argument of a WinExec call—a strcpy operation overwrites a saved TRegistry class pointer on the stack. This allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code in the context of the user by enticing them to visit a malicious webpage that instantiates the vulnerable ActiveX control. The vulnerability was discovered via its use in third-party software such as Logic Print 2013.

ZPanel includes a helper binary named zsudo, intended to allow restricted privilege escalation for administrative tasks. However, when misconfigured in /etc/sudoers, zsudo can be invoked by low-privileged users to execute arbitrary commands as root. This flaw enables local attackers with shell access to escalate privileges by writing a payload to a writable directory and executing it via zsudo. The vulnerability is particularly impactful in post-exploitation scenarios following web server compromise, where the attacker inherits access to zsudo.

An OS command injection vulnerability exists in multiple Raidsonic NAS devices—specifically tested on IB-NAS5220 and IB-NAS4220—via the unauthenticated timeHandler.cgi endpoint exposed through the web interface. The CGI script fails to properly sanitize user-supplied input in the timeZone parameter of a POST request, allowing remote attackers to inject arbitrary shell commands.

Auxilium RateMyPet contains an unauthenticated arbitrary file upload vulnerability in upload_banners.php. The banner upload feature fails to validate file types or enforce authentication, allowing remote attackers to upload malicious PHP files. These files are stored in a web-accessible /banners/ directory and can be executed directly, resulting in remote code execution.

Narcissus is vulnerable to remote code execution via improper input handling in its image configuration workflow. Specifically, the backend.php script fails to sanitize the release parameter before passing it to the configure_image() function. This function invokes PHP’s passthru() with the unsanitized input, allowing attackers to inject arbitrary system commands. Exploitation occurs via a crafted POST request, resulting in command execution under the web server’s context.

FreeFloat FTP Server contains multiple critical design flaws that allow unauthenticated remote attackers to upload arbitrary files to sensitive system directories. The server accepts empty credentials, defaults user access to the root of the C:\ drive, and imposes no restrictions on file type or destination path. These conditions enable attackers to upload executable payloads and .mof files to locations such as system32 and wbem\mof, where Windows Management Instrumentation (WMI) automatically processes and executes them. This results in remote code execution with SYSTEM-level privileges, without requiring user interaction.

A stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability exists in FreeFloat FTP Server version 1.0.0. The server fails to properly validate input passed to the USER command, allowing remote attackers to overwrite memory and potentially execute arbitrary code. The flaw is triggered by sending an overly long username string, which overflows the buffer allocated for user authentication.

Amlib’s NetOpacs webquery.dll contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability triggered by improper handling of HTTP GET parameters. Specifically, the application fails to enforce bounds on input supplied to the app parameter, allowing excessive data to overwrite memory structures including the Structured Exception Handler (SEH). Additionally, malformed parameter names followed by an equals sign may result in unintended control flow behavior. This vulnerability is exposed through IIS and affects legacy Windows deployments

WeGIA is a web manager for charitable institutions. Prior to 3.8.7, web/html/socio/sistema/atualiza_pagamentos.php performs payment-status database updates without checking whether the requester has an authenticated session. An unauthenticated remote requester can supply a payment identifier, payment date, and paid value to mark arbitrary payment records as paid or otherwise modify payment information, causing financial record corruption. This issue is fixed in version 3.8.7.

WeGIA is a web manager for charitable institutions. Prior to 3.8.7, web/html/socio/sistema/cadastro_cobranca.php creates billing records without checking for an authenticated session. An unauthenticated remote requester who supplies valid billing parameters can create arbitrary billing entries, enabling financial data manipulation and operational disruption. This issue is fixed in version 3.8.7.

WeGIA is a web manager for charitable institutions. Prior to 3.8.6, web/html/socio/sistema/cadastro_cobrancas_geracao.php performs privileged charge-generation operations without checking for an authenticated session. An unauthenticated remote requester who supplies valid charge-generation parameters can create arbitrary charge records, enabling financial record manipulation and large-scale billing corruption. This issue is fixed in version 3.8.6.

WeGIA is a web manager for charitable institutions. Prior to 3.9.1, a user with backup-management permission can upload a crafted gzip-compressed tar archive through web/html/configuracao/importar_dump.php, after which web/controle/control.php accepts a user-controlled modulo value and combines it with nomeClasse for require_once(). By using a phar:// path to the uploaded archive and selecting the whitelisted InternoControle, whose empty resource list is treated as authorized, the user can cause an embedded controller file and its requested method to execute as the web-server process. The attack path depends on the configured BKP_DIR, and enabling phar.readonly or phar.require_hash does not prevent PHP from reading the gzip tar archive through phar://. Successful exploitation permits access to or modification of sensitive data, configuration, credentials, source files, host commands, and services reachable by the web-server account. This issue is fixed in version 3.9.1.

Vulnerability in the Oracle WebCenter Content product of Oracle Fusion Middleware (component: Content Portal Suite).  Supported versions that are affected are 12.2.1.4.0 and  14.1.2.0.0. OmniFaces is a utility library for Faces. From 5.2 until 5.4.3, applications using <o:sse> or @Push(type=SSE) with session scope, view scope, or a user attribute can expose pushed messages because org.omnifaces.cdi.push.SseEndpoint#doGet accepts a channel identifier registered by SseChannelManager and PushSessionManager without verifying that the caller's HTTP session owns it. An attacker who obtains the victim's channel identifier from a logged URL, report, Referer header, or shared link can connect from a foreign or absent session and receive messages intended for the victim. Application-scoped channels are intentionally unbound, and this issue permits message receipt but not message injection. This issue is fixed in version 5.4.3.

XWiki Platform is a generic wiki platform. From 4.3-milestone-1 until 16.10.18, 17.10.5, and 18.2.0, the /rest/wikis/{wikiName}/query REST endpoint permits HQL query construction that can combine blind conditions with FROM-clause injection to join BaseObject and StringProperty, bypassing the SELECT-column whitelist. An unauthenticated attacker can recover database values from inaccessible pages, including salted SHA1 password hashes and passwords stored in configuration properties. It should be assumed that, with more complex techniques, this can work even when the attacker cannot read any wiki page. A typical password hash may require roughly 800 requests, and expensive injected queries can also degrade availability. The issue is remediated by disabling HQL and XWQL REST queries by default. This issue is fixed in versions 16.10.18, 17.10.5, and 18.2.0.

This issue is fixed in version 0.3.0.

Instatic is an open source visual content management system for building static websites. Prior to 0.0.14, isSafeUrl() and safeUrl() in src/core/html-sanitize/index.ts remove tabs, newlines, carriage returns, and characters handled by String.prototype.trim(), but leave other leading C0 control characters that browsers discard before parsing a URL scheme. A low-privileged editor can place a dangerous URL behind one of those controls in a URL property or custom HTML attribute, allowing src/core/publisher/escapeProps.ts and the shared URL sanitizer to emit it into rendered content. When an Owner or Admin activates the element in the same-origin admin editor canvas, script executes with the victim's application authority and can drive admin APIs to read protected data, create an owner account, or install a plugin. This issue is fixed in version 0.0.14.
