of the hugetlb_lock lock, ensuring that folio_hstate(folio) does not
return NULL.

An Out-of-bounds Read vulnerability [CWE-125] vulnerability in Fortinet FortiOS 7.6.0, FortiOS 7.4.0 through 7.4.4, FortiOS 7.2.0 through 7.2.9 may allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to trigger memory consumption leading to Denial of Service via crafted requests.

An Integer Overflow or Wraparound vulnerability [CWE-190] vulnerability in Fortinet FortiOS 7.4.0 through 7.4.4, FortiOS 7.2.0 through 7.2.11 may allow an authenticated attacker to crash the IPsec tunnel via crafted requests, resulting in potential denial of service.

A path traversal: '../filedir' vulnerability in Fortinet FortiOS 8.0.0 through 8.0.1, FortiOS 7.6.0 through 7.6.7, FortiOS 7.4.0 through 7.4.12, FortiOS 7.2.0 through 7.2.13, FortiPAM 1.6 all versions, FortiPAM 1.5 all versions, FortiPAM 1.4 all versions, FortiPAM 1.3 all versions, FortiPAM 1.2 all versions, FortiPAM 1.1 all versions, FortiPAM 1.0 all versions may allow an unauthenticated attacker to bypass authentication via specially crafted credentials.

In Eclipse Theia versions 1.66.0 and up until including 1.73.1, the `@theia/plugin-ext` backend exposes the `/hostedPlugin/:pluginId/:path(*)` HTTP endpoint, which resolves the requested file path with `path.resolve(localPath, filePath)` without verifying that the resolved path stays within the plugin's directory. An unauthenticated network attacker can send percent-encoded `../` sequences (`%2e%2e%2f`) that decode into the path parameter and escape the plugin directory, allowing arbitrary files readable by the Theia backend process to be retrieved. Plugin IDs are derived deterministically from a plugin's publisher and name, so built-in plugins serve as reliable anchors that require no prior knowledge of the target system.

Memory overflow in SMPP traffic can lead to unpredictable or erroneous behavior or Denial of Service in Citrix NetScaler
Memory overflow in Packet Processing can lead to unpredictable or erroneous behavior or Denial of Service in NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway.
An unauthenticated attacker can bypass authentication controls to access restricted resources on the Citrix NetScaler Console appliance

Git is a fast, scalable, distributed revision control system with an unusually rich command set that provides both high-level operations and full access to internals. Prior to 2.50.2, 2.51.3, 2.52.1, 2.53.1, 2.54.1, 2.55.1, and 2.56.1, an attacker-controlled repository hosted by the attacker rather than on a normal forge site can exploit git clone --recurse-submodules by causing Git to overwrite a submodule gitfile with a symbolic link. The symbolic link can point to a directory containing attacker-controlled Git configuration or hooks, allowing those hooks or configuration to execute code on the cloning user's system. The issue requires the recursive-submodule option, and users should avoid cloning repositories from untrusted sources. This issue is fixed in versions 2.50.2, 2.51.3, 2.52.1, 2.53.1, 2.54.1, 2.55.1, and 2.56.1.
Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Office OneNote allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.
Improper authorization in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.
Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows an authorized attacker to execute code over a network.

A maliciously crafted DLL placed in a predictable, attacker-writable temporary directory used by the Autodesk Installer can lead to privilege escalation to NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM due to insufficient validation of loaded libraries. An attacker with local and low-privilege access could exploit this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code as SYSTEM.

LibreOffice documents in ODF format can contain form controls, such as buttons and text fields, and each control names the component that implements it. The component a control named was created even when it was not a form control, and the settings stored with the control were applied to it, so a crafted document could change the configuration of LibreOffice in a way that led to code being run. In fixed versions a control whose component is not a form control is ignored.

LibreOffice can connect to databases through JDBC drivers written in Java. A spreadsheet can use a database as the source of a pivot table, and the database document that describes the connection names the driver to use. The location the driver was loaded from was taken from the database document itself, so a crafted document could make LibreOffice load and run Java code that the document supplied when it was opened. This is a different route to the problem fixed for CVE-2026-63277. In fixed versions the driver location is taken only from the driver configuration of the user, and a pivot table whose source is a database document named by a URL connects only once the user allows links to be updated.

LibreOffice bundles the HSQLDB database engine, which can be used through the generic JDBC database driver as well as through the support for embedded databases. HSQLDB lets SQL statements call Java methods, limited to the classes that are permitted. When HSQLDB was used through the generic JDBC driver this limit did not apply, so SQL in a crafted document could call any Java method and run code. In fixed versions SQL can call only the built-in functions of HSQLDB, whichever way the database is reached.

LibreOffice Calc can link a cell range to an external data source, and the link is saved in the document. A Java database driver for such a link is loaded from a class path. Opening a crafted document could still load a Java database driver from a location outside the local machine and run its code, by a route that the fix for CVE-2026-63277 did not cover. In fixed versions an entry in a Java class path has to be a file URL that names a file on the local machine.

LibreOffice can open a web query file (.iqy), which names a web page to import into a spreadsheet, when the file is given on its command line, for example when a file manager or another program opens the file with LibreOffice. The address in such a file was used without the checks that apply to an address given on the command line directly, so a crafted file could make LibreOffice do something other than open a web page, up to running code. In fixed versions only an http or https address is taken from a web query file.

A document can carry its own user interface customizations, such as keyboard shortcuts, menus and toolbars, which take effect while the document is open. A command bound in these customizations could run a macro or a script even when the macro security settings did not allow the macros of the document, so a user who pressed a shortcut or chose a menu item in a crafted document could run code without any warning. In fixed versions the customizations of a document are treated like its other macro content, and the macro and script commands in them are only kept when the macros of the document are allowed.

A type allow-list bypass in the BSON serialization library of the MongoDB C# Driver allows a type-restriction check to be circumvented when polymorphic data is deserialized into loosely typed members. An unauthorized party who can supply or plant BSON/JSON data that the application later deserializes can cause the application process to instantiate .NET types outside the intended allow-list and populate them with unauthorized party-controlled values. In applications that contain a suitable gadget type, this can lead to arbitrary code execution in the context of the application, with corresponding loss of confidentiality, integrity, and availability. No special privileges beyond the ability to introduce data the application reads are required.

A flaw was found in BusyBox. When the TFTP (Trivial File Transfer Protocol) client requests a custom small block size and receives a standard response, it falls back to the default block size without resizing the allocated memory buffer. A malicious TFTP server can exploit this issue by sending standard-sized network packets during a transfer, causing a heap buffer overflow. This flaw allows an attacker to achieve arbitrary code execution or cause a Denial of Service (DoS) by crashing the application.
A critical remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability has been reported in PTC Windchill and PTC FlexPLM. The vulnerability may be exploited through the deserialization of untrusted data.

OriginLab Origin Viewer OPJ File Parsing Out-Of-Bounds Write Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of OriginLab Origin Viewer. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file.

The specific flaw exists within the parsing of OPJ files. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in a write past the end of an allocated data structure. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process. Was ZDI-CAN-30432.

When using GCC, building a malicious package that uses cgo could cause arbitrary command execution at link time via untrusted GCC spec files ("specs" or "*.spec"). When linking with "-fopenmp", "-fopenacc", or "-fsanitize=" in "#cgo LDFLAGS", GCC's built-in link spec evaluates "%:include(libgomp.spec)" or "%:include(libsanitizer.spec)" and searches for spec files in "-L" and sysroot directories (including subdirectories and multilib sibling directories such as "../lib64"), as well as the working directory when "-fopenmp" or "-fopenacc" is used or when "-fsanitize=" is combined with "-static" or "-static-lib*". The go command now rejects "-L", "-isysroot", and "-Wl,-syslibroot" directories (and the working and package directories when applicable) that contain GCC spec files, and disallows "@" and "-" prefixes in "-fsanitize=" compiler flag values.

Building a malicious package that uses cgo could cause arbitrary code execution at build time through several compiler and linker flags permitted in "#cgo" directives. Specifically, "--sysroot" in GCC and Clang relocates compiler subprograms, spec files, and CRT startup objects to an attacker-controlled directory; "-target" in Clang falls back to executing target helper tools from the current working directory when not found in PATH; "-isysroot" and "-Wl,-syslibroot" can pass a regular file on disk to GNU ld.bfd, which interprets it as a positional linker script; and "-x" permitted specifying arbitrary compiler input languages beyond those supported by cgo. "--sysroot" and "-target" are now disallowed in "#cgo" flags, "-isysroot" and "-Wl,-syslibroot" are verified not to point to regular files, and "-x" is restricted to the C, C++, Objective-C, and assembler languages supported by cgo.

When using Clang or GCC, building a malicious package that uses cgo could cause unexpected code execution at build time or write files to arbitrary directories via "-gen-*" or "-gnat*" flags in "#cgo" directives. The "-g*" wildcard in the compiler and linker flag allowlists previously matched Clang's two-argument "-gen-cdb-fragment-path <dir>" flag and GCC's two-argument "-gnatO <file>" flag, permitting compilation database fragments and sidecar output files to be written to arbitrary directories and desynchronizing flag argument parsing between the go command and the compiler driver so that subsequent arguments could be passed as unvalidated positional inputs to the linker. "-gen-*" and "-gnat*" flags are now disallowed in "#cgo" compiler and linker flags.

On Darwin, building a malicious package that uses cgo could cause arbitrary code execution when using the Apple linker due to passing "-l to_library <path>" in a "#cgo LDFLAGS" directive. The Apple linker recombines the separated arguments "-l" and "to_library" into "-lto_library", which loads an arbitrary LTO plugin dynamic library at link time. The go command now disallows "-l" followed by "to_library" in "#cgo LDFLAGS", rejects "-lazy_library", "-lazy_framework", "-load_hidden", "-library", and "-library-path", and checks recombined "-l" arguments against disallowed linker flags and patterns.

Building a malicious package that uses cgo could cause arbitrary code execution at link time by passing linker script files to the host linker via "#cgo LDFLAGS". Split "-Wl," flags that consume a following argument (such as "-Wl,-rpath", "-Wl,--just-symbols", and "-Wl,-undefined") previously accepted a bare second argument without a "-Wl," prefix, which the compiler driver passes directly to the linker as a positional input file. Additionally, when using GNU ld.bfd, flags such as "-framework", "-Wl,-framework", "-Wl,-undefined", "-Wl,--just-symbols", "-Wl,-R", "-Wl,-subsystem", and (on non-Darwin platforms) "-Wl,-sectcreate" could cause ld.bfd to interpret their arguments as linker scripts if they named a regular file on disk. The go command now requires a "-Wl," prefix on the second token of split "-Wl," flags (except "-Wl,-R"), verifies that these flags do not reference linker script files, and disallows bare "-Wl,--warn-backrefs-exclude".

Building a malicious package containing ".syso" files or cgo linker inputs could inject arbitrary linker flags or execute arbitrary code at link time. Linker input files—including ".syso" files, direct object or library inputs in "#cgo LDFLAGS", and libraries in "-L" directories—were passed to the external linker without validating their format or checking for embedded linker options. Across platforms, this allowed executing GNU ld implicit linker scripts disguised as libraries or ".syso" files (or loaded via "-l:<filename>" or "-l" containing path separators), injecting unallowlisted linker flags via PE/COFF ".drectve" sections on Windows or Mach-O "LC_LINKER_OPTION" load commands on Darwin, or invoking LTO plugins via GCC or LLVM LTO intermediate representation sections in ELF, PE/COFF, or Mach-O objects. The go command now verifies that ".syso" files, direct linker inputs, and libraries in "-L" directories are valid binary objects or archives that do not contain unallowlisted ".drectve" directives, "LC_LINKER_OPTION" load commands, or LTO IR sections, and disallows "-l:<filename>" and ":", "=", or path separators in "-l" flags.

Building a malicious package that uses cgo could bypass "#cgo LDFLAGS" validation and cause unexpected code execution at build time, or cause the go command to panic, via crafted quoting in "//go:cgo_ldflag" directives. When "cmd/cgo" generates "_cgo_gotypes.go", it quotes each "#cgo LDFLAGS" argument with strconv.Quote in a "//go:cgo_ldflag" directive, but "cmd/compile" and "cmd/go" parsed those directives by splitting on raw quote characters without handling backslash escapes or unquoting the string. This mismatch allowed disallowed linker flags or unvalidated linker search paths to be smuggled past the go command's flag checks and passed to the external linker. In addition, deduplicating LDFLAGS in the go command could panic with an out-of-bounds slice index when a prefix of the flag list matched near the end of the slice. "cmd/compile" and "cmd/go" now properly handle backslash-escaped quotes and unquote "//go:cgo_*" pragma strings with strconv.Unquote, and the slice bounds check in processCgoOutputs has been fixed.
Incorrect permission assignment for critical resource in Samsung Update prior to version 3.0.111.0 allows local attackers to execute arbitrary code.
Dell PowerStore contains an authorization-bypass vulnerability. A low-privileged attacker could exploit it, potentially leading to elevation of privilege to administrator.
Unquoted search path or element in Samsung Device Care prior to version 4.0.80 allows local attackers to execute arbitrary code.
Improper privilege management in TransitionPlayer prior to SMR Nov-2026 Release 1 allows local privileged attackers to execute arbitrary code with launcher privilege.

Improper input validation in libMyFilterPlugin.camera.samsung.so prior to SMR Nov-2026 Release 1 allows local attackers to potentially execute arbitrary code. User interaction is required for triggering this vulnerability.
Stack-based buffer overflow in libsecuibc.so prior to SMR Nov-2026 Release 1 allows local attackers to execute arbitrary code.

On Linux and other Unix-like systems, LibreOffice can send the current document as an email attachment with File > Send > Email Document, which starts the mail client through a script bundled with LibreOffice. The script let the shell interpret the name of the document's file, so a file with a crafted name could run commands when it was sent by email. In fixed versions the script passes the file name and the other details to the mail client as plain arguments.

The Soledad theme for WordPress is vulnerable to unauthenticated Remote Code Execution in versions up to, and including, 8.7.7 The public penci_more_post_ajax AJAX action feeds infeedads[ads_code] (base64+urldecoded) to penci_safe_shortcode(), whose allowlist regex inspects only the hyphen-truncated outer shortcode name (e.g. 'adinserter') and never the nested [elementor-element k=.. data=..] tag, so do_shortcode() renders an attacker-chosen Elementor element. The rendered penci-featured-sliders widget passes its unsanitized 'style' setting to include dirname(__FILE__)."/{$style}.php", a path-traversal local file inclusion.

A improper neutralization of special elements used in an os command ('os command injection') vulnerability in Fortinet FortiMail 8.0.0 through 8.0.1, FortiMail 7.6.0 through 7.6.4, FortiMail 7.4.0 through 7.4.6, FortiMail 7.2 all versions, FortiRecorder 7.6.0 through 7.6.2, FortiRecorder 7.2.0 through 7.2.12, FortiRecorder 7.0.0 through 7.0.6 may allow an authenticated attacker to execute unauthorized code or commands via specifically crafted HTTP requests.

A stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability exists in ELAN Microelectronics Corp. ELAN Smart-Pad on Windows (ETD.sys and ETDSMBus.sys). During Intel SMBus recovery, ETDSMBus.sys does not enforce an upper-bound check on the hardware-derived report count, allowing an out-of-range value to be forwarded to ETD.sys where it is used as a loop counter for a stack buffer copy without destination size validation. A local attacker with standard user privileges can trigger a kernel bugcheck (BSOD 0xF7 DRIVER_OVERRAN_STACK_BUFFER), resulting in denial of service. This issue affects ELAN Smart-Pad through ETD24.21.52.3.

ai.summary_en: Today's curated vulnerabilities reveal a high-severity threat environment characterized by widespread remote code execution and authentication bypass flaws, particularly impacting Oracle enterprise software including E-Business Suite, WebLogic, and MySQL alongside critical network appliances from Citrix and pfSense. Industrial control and IoT sectors face significant danger from buffer overflows and command injection vulnerabilities in devices from vendors such as Philips, Cudy, and DJI, while cloud and AI workloads are exposed through unsafe deserialization and malicious model parsing risks in platforms like Arize AI and llama.cpp. Additional notable threats target mobile and desktop users via Samsung device management weaknesses and parser flaws in applications like AutoCAD and VirtualBox, emphasizing the pervasive nature of memory corruption and configuration errors across diverse technology stacks.
ai.summary_zh: 今日精选漏洞揭示了一个高危威胁环境，其特征为广泛存在的远程代码执行与身份认证绕过缺陷，主要波及Oracle企业级软件（包括E-Business Suite、WebLogic和MySQL）以及Citrix和pfSense的关键网络设备。工业控制与物联网领域正面临来自Philips、Cudy和DJI等设备厂商的缓冲区溢出与命令注入漏洞的严重威胁；与此同时，Arize AI和llama.cpp等平台因不安全的反序列化及恶意模型解析风险，致使云与AI工作负载暴露于危险之中。其他显著威胁则针对移动与桌面用户，涉及Samsung设备管理缺陷及AutoCAD、VirtualBox等应用的解析器漏洞，进一步凸显了内存破坏与配置错误在不同技术栈中的普遍性。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated compromise via RDP in Oracle VM VirtualBox poses significant risks to desktop virtualization environments and developer workstations.
items.reason_zh: 通过 RDP 对 Oracle VM VirtualBox 进行未认证访问可导致系统失陷，对桌面虚拟化环境和开发者工作站构成重大风险。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in KDE Gwenview allows remote code execution when processing malicious PNG images, directly impacting Linux desktop users.
items.reason_zh: KDE Gwenview 中的整数溢出漏洞在处理恶意 PNG 图像时可导致远程代码执行，直接影响 Linux 桌面用户。

items.reason_en: Directory traversal and out-of-bounds write flaws in KiCad enable remote code execution via malicious project archives, threatening electronic design workflows.
items.reason_zh: KiCad 中的目录遍历和越界写入缺陷可通过恶意项目归档文件实现远程代码执行，威胁电子设计工作流程。

items.reason_en: Sandbox escape in the Servo web rendering engine permits unauthorized JavaScript execution, compromising applications relying on embedded web views.
items.reason_zh: Servo 网页渲染引擎中的沙箱逃逸漏洞允许未经授权执行 JavaScript 代码，影响依赖嵌入式 Web 视图的应用程序。

items.reason_en: MicroWorld eScan AV's flawed update verification allows man-in-the-middle attacks, potentially compromising endpoint security across Windows environments.
items.reason_zh: MicroWorld eScan AV 的更新验证缺陷可遭中间人攻击利用，可能破坏 Windows 环境下的终端安全性。

items.reason_en: A stack-based buffer overflow in the Synactis PDF ActiveX control enables local code execution when processing maliciously crafted documents.
items.reason_zh: Synactis PDF ActiveX 控件中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞在处理恶意构造的文档时可导致本地代码执行。

items.reason_en: Oracle VM VirtualBox core flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to compromise the host infrastructure running the virtualization software.
items.reason_zh: Oracle VM VirtualBox 核心缺陷允许未认证攻击者攻陷运行该虚拟化软件的宿主机基础设施。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in AutoCAD's DXF parser allows remote code execution when opening malicious CAD drawings, posing significant risk to engineering and design workstations.
items.reason_zh: AutoCAD 的 DXF 解析器中存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，打开恶意 CAD 图纸时可导致远程代码执行，对工程与设计工作站构成重大风险。

items.reason_en: Untrusted search path vulnerability in Dell SupportAssist OS Recovery enables local privilege escalation for low-privileged users with physical or console access.
items.reason_zh: Dell SupportAssist OS Recovery 中的不可信搜索路径漏洞可使具备物理或控制台访问权限的低权限用户实现本地提权。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read/write in the VB-Audio kernel streaming driver allows standard users to crash audio subsystems or escalate privileges via malformed property handlers.
items.reason_zh: VB-Audio 内核流驱动中的越界读写漏洞允许普通用户通过畸形属性处理程序导致音频子系统崩溃或实现提权。

items.reason_en: Macro security settings are bypassed for Base document events, allowing automatic execution of malicious code upon opening documents, which compromises desktop system integrity.
items.reason_zh: Base 文档事件绕过了宏安全设置，在打开文档时自动执行恶意代码，从而破坏桌面系统的完整性。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Media Foundation enables local privilege escalation, posing a direct threat to workstation and desktop security postures.
items.reason_zh: Windows Media Foundation 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可实现本地提权，直接威胁工作站与桌面的安全态势。

items.reason_en: Relative path traversal in PowerShell allows network-based code execution, significantly expanding the attack surface for Windows administration and scripting environments.
items.reason_zh: PowerShell 中的相对路径遍历漏洞允许基于网络的代码执行，显著扩大了 Windows 管理与脚本环境的攻击面。

items.reason_en: Local privilege escalation in Iperius Backup stems from insufficient separation between its elevated GUI and low-privilege users, allowing arbitrary code execution as Administrator.
items.reason_zh: Iperius Backup 的本地提权漏洞源于其高权限 GUI 与低权限用户之间的隔离不足，允许以管理员身份执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: A stack buffer overflow in X.Org xwayland's device valuator handling enables authenticated clients to crash or execute arbitrary code within the X server environment.
items.reason_zh: X.Org xwayland 的设备值处理器处理中存在栈缓冲区溢出漏洞，使已认证客户端能够导致 X 服务器环境崩溃或执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Sandboxie-Plus contains a local privilege escalation flaw where standard users can launch executables as SYSTEM by abusing service requests and bypassing signature verification.
items.reason_zh: Sandboxie-Plus 存在本地提权缺陷，标准用户可通过滥用服务请求并绕过签名验证，以 SYSTEM 身份启动可执行文件。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Office OneNote enables network-based remote code execution by an unauthorized attacker.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office OneNote 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许未授权攻击者通过网络进行远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: LibreOffice Calc can be tricked into loading and executing malicious Java database drivers from external paths when opening crafted documents.
items.reason_zh: 打开构造的文档时，LibreOffice Calc 可能被诱骗从外部路径加载并执行恶意的 Java 数据库驱动程序。

items.reason_en: Document-level UI customizations can bypass macro security settings to execute scripts or macros unexpectedly.
items.reason_zh: 文档级别的 UI 自定义功能可绕过宏安全设置，意外执行脚本或宏。

items.reason_en: Binding to unrestricted IP addresses in Samsung Smart Switch allows adjacent attackers to bypass authentication, compromising mobile device synchronization and user data privacy.
items.reason_zh: Samsung Smart Switch 绑定到无限制 IP 地址的漏洞允许邻近攻击者绕过身份验证，危及移动设备同步与用户数据隐私。

items.reason_en: Path traversal vulnerability in the PocketBook Android reader exposes sensitive files to unauthorized actors, directly impacting mobile data confidentiality.
items.reason_zh: PocketBook Android 阅读器中的路径遍历漏洞会将敏感文件暴露给未授权实体，直接影响移动数据的机密性。

items.reason_en: Incorrect permission assignments in Samsung Update allow local attackers to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code.
items.reason_zh: Samsung Update 中不正确的权限分配允许本地攻击者提权并执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Unquoted search path vulnerabilities in Samsung Device Care enable local privilege escalation through malicious executable placement.
items.reason_zh: Samsung Device Care 中的未加引号搜索路径漏洞可通过放置恶意可执行文件实现本地提权。

items.reason_en: Buffer overflow in Snap7 client library allows malicious PLCs to crash or execute code on connected systems, directly endangering industrial control networks.
items.reason_zh: Snap7 客户端库中的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许恶意 PLC 导致连接系统崩溃或执行代码，直接危及工业控制网络。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow and default credential bypass in Philips Hue Bridge enable unauthenticated remote code execution on smart home hubs.
items.reason_zh: Philips Hue Bridge 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出及默认凭据绕过漏洞可在智能家庭集线器上实现未认证的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Command injection vulnerability in Lantronix industrial IoT gateways allows authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary shell commands as root.
items.reason_zh: Lantronix 工业物联网网关中的命令注入漏洞允许已认证攻击者以 root 权限执行任意 Shell 命令。

items.reason_en: Type confusion in ESP-IDF BLE Mesh stack can cause unexpected attribute handling, potentially disrupting wireless IoT mesh networks.
items.reason_zh: ESP-IDF BLE Mesh 协议栈中的类型混淆漏洞可能导致意外的属性处理，进而干扰无线物联网网状网络。

items.reason_en: Pervasive unauthenticated command injection across multiple configuration interfaces allows complete takeover of consumer Wi-Fi repeaters.
items.reason_zh: 多个配置接口中普遍存在的未认证命令注入漏洞可导致消费级 Wi-Fi 中继器被完全接管。

items.reason_en: COMMAX Smart Home System exposes RTSP credentials in plaintext, granting attackers unauthorized access to live surveillance feeds.
items.reason_zh: COMMAX Smart Home System 以明文形式暴露 RTSP 凭据，使攻击者能够未经授权访问实时监控画面。

items.reason_en: DBLTek GoIP VoIP gateways contain a fundamentally flawed backdoor scheme that permits unauthenticated remote command execution.
items.reason_zh: DBLTek GoIP VoIP 网关包含存在根本缺陷的后门机制，允许未认证的远程命令执行。

items.reason_en: ARMBot robotics platform suffers from an unrestricted file upload vulnerability, enabling attackers to deploy and execute arbitrary code.
items.reason_zh: ARMBot 机器人平台存在未限制的文件上传漏洞，攻击者可利用该漏洞部署并执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated stack buffer overflow in the Cudy TR3000 router's STUN parser enables remote code execution via a single crafted UDP datagram targeting exposed network devices.
items.reason_zh: Cudy TR3000 路由器的 STUN 解析器中存在未认证的栈缓冲区溢出漏洞，攻击者可通过针对暴露网络设备的单个构造 UDP 数据报实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Mass assignment flaw in Cudy firmware allows authenticated administrators to inject arbitrary OpenVPN server options, potentially compromising entire network tunnel configurations.
items.reason_zh: Cudy 固件中的批量赋值缺陷允许已认证的管理员注入任意 OpenVPN 服务器选项，可能导致整个网络隧道配置被破坏。

items.reason_en: Invalid timestamp length validation causes out-of-bounds writes during deserialization, leading to crashes or arbitrary code execution in IoT messaging protocols.
items.reason_zh: 无效的时间戳长度验证会导致反序列化期间发生越界写入，从而在物联网消息协议中引发崩溃或任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: Stored XSS in the Microchip TimePictra platform allows low-privileged attackers to execute malicious scripts, compromising user sessions and operational data.
items.reason_zh: Microchip TimePictra 平台存在存储型跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞，低权限攻击者可借此执行恶意脚本，危及用户会话与业务数据。

items.reason_en: Unreachable exit condition in device certificate verification causes denial of service, disrupting IoT hub connectivity and device lifecycle management.
items.reason_zh: 设备证书验证逻辑中存在不可达的退出条件会导致拒绝服务，中断物联网中心连接及设备生命周期管理。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in DJI AeroScope firmware management allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary commands on the communications board via network configuration endpoints.
items.reason_zh: DJI AeroScope 固件管理系统存在操作系统命令注入漏洞，未认证攻击者可通过网络配置接口在通信板上执行任意命令。

items.reason_en: The Zephyr Project charger driver fails to inspect union members before copying data across the user/kernel boundary, exposing function pointers that risk local privilege escalation on embedded devices.
items.reason_zh: Zephyr Project 充电器驱动程序在跨越用户态/内核态边界复制数据前未检查联合体成员，导致函数指针泄露，可能引发嵌入式设备上的本地提权。

items.reason_en: Unrestricted file upload in the VITEC EZ TV Platform Server permits unauthenticated remote attackers to deploy arbitrary files and achieve full system compromise without authentication.
items.reason_zh: VITEC EZ TV Platform Server 存在未限制的文件上传漏洞，远程攻击者可在未认证情况下上传任意文件并实现系统完全接管。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in the ELECOM router's WebGUI allows authenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary system commands.
items.reason_zh: ELECOM 路由器 WebGUI 存在操作系统命令注入漏洞，已认证远程攻击者可执行任意系统命令。

items.reason_en: A buffer handling flaw in BusyBox TFTP client allows malicious servers to trigger memory corruption and potentially execute code.
items.reason_zh: BusyBox TFTP 客户端存在缓冲区处理缺陷，恶意服务器可利用该缺陷触发内存损坏并可能执行代码。

items.reason_en: Critical remote code execution in Arize AI Phoenix via crafted GraphQL queries threatens cloud-based machine learning observability platforms.
items.reason_zh: 通过构造 GraphQL 查询可在 Arize AI Phoenix 中触发关键级远程代码执行漏洞，威胁基于云的机器学习可观测性平台。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in ArtisanCloud PowerX IAM API allows tenant members to escalate privileges and modify cross-tenant permissions.
items.reason_zh: ArtisanCloud PowerX IAM API 存在授权缺失缺陷，租户成员可利用该缺陷提升权限并修改跨租户权限。

items.reason_en: Unsafe reflection in ModelScope AI pipeline enables remote code execution via malicious model configurations, compromising cloud AI services.
items.reason_zh: ModelScope AI 流水线中存在不安全的反射机制，攻击者可通过恶意模型配置实现远程代码执行，危及云 AI 服务。

items.reason_en: Hardcoded SSH private key and unrestricted sudo rules in Vasion Print virtual appliances allow trivial remote administrative access.
items.reason_zh: Vasion Print 虚拟设备中存在硬编码的 SSH 私钥及未限制的 sudo 规则，攻击者可轻易获取远程管理访问权限。

items.reason_en: H3C CAS cloud platform contains an unauthenticated file upload flaw that allows remote attackers to achieve full system compromise.
items.reason_zh: H3C CAS 云平台存在未认证的文件上传缺陷，远程攻击者可利用该缺陷实现系统完全接管。

items.reason_en: Fumasoft Cloud platform suffers from unauthenticated SQL injection, risking complete database exfiltration and administrative takeover.
items.reason_zh: Fumasoft Cloud 平台存在未认证的 SQL 注入漏洞，可能导致数据库完整泄露及管理权限被接管。

items.reason_en: ZPanel hosting control panel misconfiguration allows low-privileged users to escalate privileges to root via a helper binary.
items.reason_zh: ZPanel 主机控制面板配置不当，低权限用户可通过辅助二进制程序将权限提升至 root。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Puppet Server permits arbitrary code execution under any CA-signed agent certificate; actively exploited in the wild per CISA KEV.
items.reason_zh: Puppet Server 对不受信任数据进行反序列化可导致任意代码执行，且该漏洞适用于任何由 CA 签名的代理证书；据 CISA KEV 记录，该漏洞已在野外被主动利用。

items.reason_en: Authentication token confusion in Rucio allows unauthenticated attackers to forge valid tokens by exploiting nonce/token table overlap, granting unauthorized access to scientific data clusters.
items.reason_zh: Rucio 中存在身份验证令牌混淆漏洞，未认证攻击者可利用 nonce/令牌表重叠伪造有效令牌，从而未经授权访问科学数据集群。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in OpenBao's transit key import functionality bypasses ACL name constraints, allowing attackers to store unauthorized cryptographic key material in restricted paths.
items.reason_zh: OpenBao 的 transit 密钥导入功能存在路径遍历漏洞，可绕过 ACL 名称限制，使攻击者能够将未经授权的加密密钥材料存储在受限路径中。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in Broadcom AutoSys workload automation modules allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands, severely compromising server orchestration.
items.reason_zh: Broadcom AutoSys 工作负载自动化模块存在操作系统命令注入漏洞，远程攻击者可执行任意命令，严重破坏服务器编排功能。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated API endpoint in AsiaInfo BSS allows remote attackers to provision administrative accounts, granting full control over critical business support systems.
items.reason_zh: AsiaInfo BSS 存在未认证的 API 接口，远程攻击者可创建管理员账户，从而完全控制关键业务支撑系统。

items.reason_en: High-severity path traversal in Atlassian Data Center products allows arbitrary read/write operations, potentially leading to full system compromise in cloud deployments.
items.reason_zh: Atlassian Data Center 产品中存在高危路径遍历漏洞，支持任意读写操作，在云部署环境中可能导致系统完全接管。

items.reason_en: OpenFunction namespace tenants can create privileged host-access pods via unrestricted PodSpec templates, breaking cluster isolation and enabling full node compromise.
items.reason_zh: OpenFunction 命名空间租户可通过未限制的 PodSpec 模板创建具有特权的主机访问 Pod，破坏集群隔离性并实现节点完全接管。

items.reason_en: Octopus Server's OIDC token validation flaw allows account editors to impersonate other projects, granting unauthorized access to downstream cloud resources and deployment pipelines.
items.reason_zh: Octopus Server 的 OIDC 令牌验证缺陷允许账户编辑者冒充其他项目，从而未经授权访问下游云资源及部署流水线。

items.reason_en: Docker Sandboxes fails to verify directory ownership, allowing local unprivileged users to hijack control-plane sockets and escalate privileges when the sandbox daemon runs as root.
items.reason_zh: Docker Sandboxes 未验证目录所有权，当沙箱守护进程以 root 身份运行时，本地无权限用户可劫持控制平面套接字并提升权限。

items.reason_en: Stale FrankenPHP Docker images fail to propagate underlying security patches, leaving deployments vulnerable to known exploits like libcrypto3 flaws.
items.reason_zh: 过期的 FrankenPHP Docker 镜像未能同步底层安全补丁，导致部署环境易受已知漏洞（如 libcrypto3 缺陷）利用。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated exposure of LND macaroon credential files in BTCPay Server grants attackers full control over Lightning Network nodes.
items.reason_zh: BTCPay Server 未认证公开了 LND macaroon 凭证文件，攻击者可借此完全控制 Lightning Network 节点。

items.reason_en: Insecure software update metadata processing in N-able N-central allows attackers to write files outside intended directories and achieve remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: N-able N-central 的软件更新元数据处理存在安全缺陷，攻击者可向预期目录外写入文件并实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Incorrect authorization in pfSense XML-RPC interface allows authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on widely deployed firewall appliances.
items.reason_zh: pfSense XML-RPC 接口中的错误授权允许已认证攻击者在广泛部署的防火墙设备上执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated OS command injection in Shenzhen Aitemi Wi-Fi repeaters enables attackers to fully compromise network infrastructure and intercept traffic.
items.reason_zh: Shenzhen Aitemi Wi-Fi 中继器中的未认证操作系统命令注入漏洞使攻击者能够完全控制网络基础设施并拦截流量。

items.reason_en: Session management flaw in FreeSWITCH RTP processing can lead to call hijacking or denial of service in VoIP deployments.
items.reason_zh: FreeSWITCH RTP 处理过程中的会话管理缺陷可能导致 VoIP 部署中的呼叫劫持或拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in tac_plus-ng allows clients with valid shared keys to crash or execute code, impacting network authentication infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: tac_plus-ng 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许持有有效共享密钥的客户端导致程序崩溃或执行代码，影响网络认证基础设施。

items.reason_en: Multiple D-Link DIR-series routers allow unauthenticated remote code execution due to improper input validation in their management interface.
items.reason_zh: 由于管理接口中缺乏适当的输入验证，多款 D-Link DIR 系列路由器存在未认证的远程代码执行漏洞。

items.reason_en: Ruijie RG-UAC application gateway permits unauthenticated command injection, directly compromising network perimeter appliances.
items.reason_zh: Ruijie RG-UAC 应用网关允许未认证命令注入，直接危及网络边界设备的安全。

items.reason_en: NSFOCUS SecGate3600 firewall fails to enforce authentication on sensitive endpoints, exposing user data to unauthenticated remote attackers.
items.reason_zh: NSFOCUS SecGate3600 防火墙未在敏感端点上强制执行身份验证，导致用户数据暴露给未认证的远程攻击者。

items.reason_en: Improper initialization in the Linksys EA8100 SMB service script enables remote code execution by manipulating anonymous access parameters on consumer-grade routers.
items.reason_zh: Linksys EA8100 SMB 服务脚本中的初始化不当漏洞，允许通过操纵消费级路由器上的匿名访问参数实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Lack of connection and request-rate limits in Pi-hole's CivetWeb interface allows unauthenticated denial-of-service via sustained CPU exhaustion on network-level ad blockers.
items.reason_zh: Pi-hole 的 CivetWeb 接口缺乏连接数和请求速率限制，攻击者可通过持续耗尽 CPU 资源对网络级广告拦截器实施未认证的拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: Memory corruption in FreeSWITCH's RTP packet handling after peer closure enables remote exploitation of VoIP infrastructure, disrupting telecommunications services.
items.reason_zh: FreeSWITCH 在对等方关闭后的 RTP 包处理过程中存在内存损坏漏洞，可导致 VoIP 基础设施被远程利用，从而中断电信服务。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in Zyxel firmware library enables privilege escalation and arbitrary command execution, posing a severe threat to router and appliance integrity.
items.reason_zh: Zyxel 固件库中的越界写入漏洞可提升权限并执行任意命令，对路由器和设备的完整性构成严重威胁。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in ManageEngine DDI Central sync APIs allows unauthenticated impersonation of servers, enabling unauthorized DNS and DHCP modifications.
items.reason_zh: ManageEngine DDI Central 同步 API 中的身份验证绕过漏洞允许未认证伪造服务器身份，从而实现未经授权的 DNS 和 DHCP 修改。

items.reason_en: Authorization bypass permits non-administrative users to modify DHCP options across unauthorized clusters, disrupting enterprise network address management.
items.reason_zh: 权限绕过漏洞允许非管理员用户在未经授权集群中修改 DHCP 选项，破坏企业网络地址管理。

items.reason_en: Multiple memory overflow vulnerabilities in Citrix NetScaler ADC/Gateway lead to unpredictable behavior or denial of service across core network processing functions.
items.reason_zh: Citrix NetScaler ADC/Gateway 中的多个内存溢出漏洞会导致核心网络处理功能出现不可预测行为或拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: Memory overflow in Citrix ICA proxy datapaths causes severe instability or DoS, directly disrupting secure remote access infrastructure and enterprise connectivity.
items.reason_zh: Citrix ICA 代理数据路径中的内存溢出漏洞会导致严重的不稳定或拒绝服务，直接破坏安全远程访问基础设施和企业网络连接。

items.reason_en: FRRouting double-free bug during dynamic BGP neighbor disconnects can trigger daemon crashes or potential code execution in routing infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: FRRouting 在动态 BGP 邻居断开连接时存在双重释放漏洞，可能触发守护进程崩溃或在路由基础设施中潜在地执行代码。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Linux kernel's ksmbd SMB handler can be triggered remotely to corrupt memory and potentially execute arbitrary code.
items.reason_zh: Linux 内核 ksmbd SMB 处理程序中的释放后使用漏洞可被远程触发以破坏内存并可能执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Citrix NetScaler Console appliances suffer from authentication bypass flaws that let unauthenticated attackers access restricted administrative resources.
items.reason_zh: Citrix NetScaler Console 设备存在身份验证绕过缺陷，允许未认证攻击者访问受限的管理资源。

items.reason_en: Fortinet FortiAnalyzer devices are vulnerable to authentication bypass via header spoofing, granting unauthorized access to management interfaces.
items.reason_zh: Fortinet FortiAnalyzer 设备易受通过标头欺骗实现的身份验证绕过漏洞影响，从而获得对管理接口的未授权访问。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in Fortinet email gateway and recording appliances enables remote attackers to execute arbitrary system commands, potentially leading to full device compromise.
items.reason_zh: Fortinet 邮件网关和录音设备中的操作系统命令注入漏洞使远程攻击者能够执行任意系统命令，可能导致设备被完全控制。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free vulnerability in open62541 OPC UA subscription handling allows remote code execution, threatening critical industrial communication protocols.
items.reason_zh: open62541 OPC UA 订阅处理中的释放后使用漏洞允许远程代码执行，危及关键工业通信协议。

items.reason_en: BYTEVALUE Intelligent Flow Control Router contains a command injection vulnerability that allows attackers to gain remote shell access to critical infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: BYTEVALUE 智能流量控制路由器存在命令注入漏洞，允许攻击者获取关键基础设施的远程 Shell 访问权限。

items.reason_en: Epross AVCON6 systems management platform suffers from OGNL injection, enabling unauthenticated remote code execution in enterprise control environments.
items.reason_zh: Epross AVCON6 系统管理平台存在 OGNL 注入漏洞，可在企业控制环境中实现未认证的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Malformed ReadPropertyMultiple requests in the BACnet Stack trigger a denial-of-service in building automation controllers, disrupting HVAC and facility management systems.
items.reason_zh: BACnet Stack 中格式错误的 ReadPropertyMultiple 请求会触发楼宇自动化控制器的拒绝服务，破坏暖通空调及设施管理系统。

items.reason_en: Remotely reachable DoS in the default BACnet demo server affects embedded control systems utilizing the open-source protocol stack for industrial communication.
items.reason_zh: 默认 BACnet 演示服务器中存在可远程触发的拒绝服务漏洞，影响采用开源协议栈进行工业通信的嵌入式控制系统。

items.reason_en: Critical JWT authentication bypass in Circutor SCADA software allows unauthenticated remote attackers to gain full control, severely impacting critical infrastructure monitoring.
items.reason_zh: Circutor SCADA 软件中存在关键的 JWT 身份验证绕过漏洞，允许未认证远程攻击者获取完全控制权，严重影响关键基础设施监控。

items.reason_en: SQL injection via tampered network traffic enables unauthenticated command execution against local healthcare databases, posing significant risk to industrial control systems.
items.reason_zh: 通过篡改网络流量实施的 SQL 注入漏洞可实现针对本地医疗数据库的未认证命令执行，对工业控制系统构成重大风险。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free vulnerability in Fuji Electric TELLUS file parsing allows information disclosure or arbitrary code execution, threatening industrial software stability.
items.reason_zh: Fuji Electric TELLUS 文件解析中的释放后使用漏洞可导致信息泄露或任意代码执行，威胁工业软件的稳定性。

items.reason_en: Johnson Controls iSTAR building management systems ship with default credentials, enabling attackers to bypass authentication and gain administrative control over critical HVAC and security hardware.
items.reason_zh: Johnson Controls iSTAR 楼宇管理系统预置了默认凭据，使攻击者能够绕过身份验证并获得关键暖通空调及安全硬件的管理员控制权。

items.reason_en: Codesys products process unvalidated server-supplied URLs, allowing MITM attacks or malicious server redirection that can compromise industrial automation workflows and controller configurations.
items.reason_zh: Codesys 产品处理未经验证的服务器提供 URL，允许中间人攻击或恶意服务器重定向，从而危及工业自动化工作流和控制器配置。

items.reason_en: P-Net routes alarm frames without source verification, allowing adjacent hosts to abort established application relationships and disrupt deterministic industrial communication.
items.reason_zh: P-Net在未进行来源验证的情况下路由告警帧，允许相邻主机中止已建立的应用关系并破坏确定性工业通信。

items.reason_en: Critical deserialization vulnerability in PTC Windchill and FlexPLM platforms allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code upon processing untrusted data.
items.reason_zh: PTC Windchill和FlexPLM平台存在严重的反序列化漏洞，远程攻击者在处理不受信任的数据时可执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Authenticated SQL injection in ILIAS e-learning platform allows attackers to extract sensitive educational data or manipulate user records.
items.reason_zh: ILIAS电子学习平台存在需认证的SQL注入漏洞，攻击者可提取敏感教育数据或操纵用户记录。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass and directory traversal flaws in SmarterMail enable attackers to take over mail accounts or execute code remotely.
items.reason_zh: SmarterMail存在身份验证绕过和目录遍历缺陷，使攻击者能够接管邮件账户或远程执行代码。

items.reason_en: Template sandbox bypass in TwigPHP allows attackers with rendering capabilities to execute arbitrary PHP code during template processing.
items.reason_zh: TwigPHP的模板沙箱绕过漏洞允许具备渲染能力的攻击者在模板处理期间执行任意PHP代码。

items.reason_en: Hardcoded JWT secret in NodePress enables unauthenticated attackers to forge administrator tokens and gain full control over WordPress deployments.
items.reason_zh: NodePress中存在硬编码的JWT密钥，使未认证攻击者能够伪造管理员令牌并完全控制WordPress部署。

items.reason_en: Misconfigured default setup invitations in Atomic Server allow unauthenticated attackers to gain write access to headless CMS databases.
items.reason_zh: Atomic Server中配置错误的默认设置邀请漏洞允许未认证攻击者获取对无头CMS数据库的写入权限。

items.reason_en: Redsea Cloud eHR platform allows unauthenticated file uploads leading to remote code execution via disguised JSP webshells.
items.reason_zh: Redsea Cloud eHR平台允许未认证的文件上传，导致通过伪装JSP Webshell实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: St. Joe ERP system contains an unauthenticated SQL injection flaw that enables arbitrary database manipulation and data exfiltration.
items.reason_zh: St. Joe ERP系统存在未认证的SQL注入缺陷，可被用于任意数据库篡改和数据外泄。

items.reason_en: WeGIA charitable institution web manager lacks session validation, allowing unauthenticated attackers to manipulate payment statuses and financial records.
items.reason_zh: WeGIA慈善机构网络管理器缺乏会话验证，允许未认证攻击者操纵支付状态和财务记录。

items.reason_en: CVSS 10.0 unauthenticated HTTP flaw in Oracle BI Platform Security allows complete takeover of business intelligence reporting and analytics interfaces.
items.reason_zh: Oracle BI Platform Security中存在CVSS评分为10.0的未认证HTTP缺陷，可导致商业智能报表与分析接口被完全接管。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.8 unauthenticated HTTP vulnerability in Oracle E-Business Suite REST Services enables full system compromise in critical ERP environments.
items.reason_zh: Oracle E-Business Suite REST Services中存在CVSS评分为9.8的未认证HTTP漏洞，可在关键ERP环境中导致系统被完全控制。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.8 core component flaw in Oracle E-Business Suite allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass foundational application security controls.
items.reason_zh: Oracle E-Business Suite的核心组件存在CVSS评分为9.8的缺陷，允许未认证攻击者绕过基础应用安全控制。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.8 unauthenticated HTTP exploit in Oracle E-Business Suite Document Management compromises file storage and collaboration workflows.
items.reason_zh: Oracle E-Business Suite Document Management中存在CVSS评分为9.8的未认证HTTP漏洞，会危及文件存储与协作工作流。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.3 unauthenticated HTTP vulnerability in PeopleSoft Integration Broker allows attackers to intercept and manipulate enterprise integration traffic.
items.reason_zh: PeopleSoft Integration Broker中存在CVSS评分为9.3的未认证HTTP漏洞，允许攻击者拦截并操纵企业集成流量。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.6 unauthenticated HTTP flaw in Oracle Hyperion Planning Security threatens financial forecasting models and sensitive corporate data.
items.reason_zh: Oracle Hyperion Planning Security中存在CVSS评分为9.6的未认证HTTP缺陷，将威胁财务预测模型及敏感企业数据。

items.reason_en: Hardcoded JWT secret in the BISHENG AI platform allows offline token forgery for unauthenticated administrator impersonation, compromising enterprise AI workflows.
items.reason_zh: BISHENG AI平台存在硬编码JWT密钥，允许未认证攻击者进行离线令牌伪造以冒充管理员，进而破坏企业AI工作流。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated path traversal in Atlassian Jira enables arbitrary file read/write operations across enterprise project management instances.
items.reason_zh: Atlassian Jira存在未认证的路径遍历漏洞，可在企业项目管理实例中实现任意文件读写操作。

items.reason_en: Code injection in Dolibarr ERP allows website editors to execute arbitrary PHP code by importing malicious templates, bypassing standard permission controls.
items.reason_zh: Dolibarr ERP存在代码注入漏洞，网站编辑可通过导入恶意模板执行任意PHP代码，从而绕过标准权限控制。

items.reason_en: HQL query construction via XWiki REST endpoints enables blind SQL injection and data exfiltration through FROM-clause manipulation and condition combination.
items.reason_zh: 通过XWiki REST端点构造HQL查询可实现盲SQL注入与数据外泄，具体通过操纵FROM子句与组合条件达成。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in wpForo Forum enables object injection, potentially leading to remote code execution and complete platform compromise.
items.reason_zh: wpForo Forum中对不受信任数据进行反序列化可引发对象注入，可能导致远程代码执行及平台完全沦陷。

items.reason_en: Authenticated users can execute arbitrary JavaScript in GitLab wiki pages, enabling session hijacking and data exfiltration in widely used development platforms.
items.reason_zh: 已认证用户可在GitLab Wiki页面中执行任意JavaScript代码，在广泛使用的开发平台中引发会话劫持与数据外泄风险。

items.reason_en: Blind SQL injection in Dolibarr WhatsApp module webhook receiver allows attackers to extract database contents, compromising business communication integrations.
items.reason_zh: Dolibarr WhatsApp模块的Webhook接收器存在盲SQL注入漏洞，攻击者可借此提取数据库内容，进而破坏业务通信集成。

items.reason_en: Unvalidated filter descriptors in Progress Telerik UI components allow unauthenticated attackers to trigger exceptions or bypass security controls, impacting web stability.
items.reason_zh: Progress Telerik UI组件中存在未验证的过滤器描述符，允许未认证攻击者触发异常或绕过安全控制，从而影响Web稳定性。

items.reason_en: Apache Shiro's DefaultLdapRealm caching skips LDAP bind verification after initial login, allowing subsequent authentication attempts with any password to succeed.
items.reason_zh: Apache Shiro的DefaultLdapRealm缓存机制在初始登录后跳过LDAP绑定验证，导致使用任意密码的后续身份验证尝试均可成功。

items.reason_en: Apache Roller contains a CSRF flaw that allows unauthenticated attackers to create administrator accounts by tricking logged-in admins into opening maliciously crafted links.
items.reason_zh: Apache Roller存在CSRF漏洞，攻击者可诱骗已登录管理员点击恶意链接，从而创建管理员账户。

items.reason_en: Vvveb's theme installer uses weak path matching, enabling admin users to upload PHP payloads via ZIP archives and achieve remote code execution on web servers.
items.reason_zh: Vvveb的主题安装程序使用弱路径匹配机制，允许管理员用户上传ZIP压缩包内的PHP载荷，进而在Web服务器上实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Batflat CMS fails to sanitize contact form inputs, allowing unauthenticated attackers to inject and execute arbitrary PHP code.
items.reason_zh: Batflat CMS未能对联系表单输入进行过滤，允许未认证攻击者注入并执行任意PHP代码。

items.reason_en: Ghost CMS API contains an authentication bypass that skips OTP verification, enabling unauthenticated account takeover.
items.reason_zh: Ghost CMS API存在身份验证绕过漏洞，该漏洞跳过了OTP验证，导致未认证攻击者可接管账户。

items.reason_en: Apache Roller's XML-RPC endpoint deserializes untrusted vendor extensions before authentication, leading to immediate remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: Apache Roller的XML-RPC端点在身份验证前反序列化不受信任的厂商扩展，直接导致远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: TYPO3's installation wizard can be re-enabled without authentication by placing a specific file in the web root, allowing complete system reconfiguration.
items.reason_zh: 通过在Web根目录放置特定文件，无需身份验证即可重新启用TYPO3的安装向导，从而导致系统可被完全重新配置。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated RCE in a widely deployed WordPress theme allows attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected sites, directly compromising web infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: 广泛部署的WordPress主题中存在未授权远程代码执行漏洞，攻击者可在受影响站点上执行任意代码，直接破坏Web基础设施。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated remote code execution via SOAP in Oracle WebLogic Server enables immediate system compromise without credentials.
items.reason_zh: Oracle WebLogic Server中通过SOAP协议实现的未授权远程代码执行漏洞，可在无凭据的情况下立即导致系统沦陷。

items.reason_en: Critical vulnerability in MySQL client programs allows network-based compromise, threatening database integrity and application connectivity.
items.reason_zh: MySQL客户端程序存在关键性漏洞，可导致基于网络的入侵，威胁数据库完整性及应用连接性。

items.reason_en: Oracle WebLogic Server TopLink Integration flaw allows unauthenticated remote code execution via HTTP, threatening enterprise middleware deployments.
items.reason_zh: Oracle WebLogic Server TopLink集成模块存在缺陷，允许通过HTTP进行未授权远程代码执行，危及企业中间件部署。

items.reason_en: Oracle Access Manager Authentication Engine vulnerability permits unauthenticated compromise via HTTP, undermining centralized identity management.
items.reason_zh: Oracle Access Manager认证引擎存在漏洞，可通过HTTP实现未授权入侵，破坏集中式身份管理。

items.reason_en: Oracle MySQL Server GIS component contains an easily exploitable vulnerability that impacts database stability and data integrity.
items.reason_zh: Oracle MySQL Server GIS组件包含一个易于利用的漏洞，会影响数据库稳定性与数据完整性。

items.reason_en: Oracle Hyperion Lifecycle Management allows unauthenticated attackers to compromise enterprise planning and analytics infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Oracle Hyperion Lifecycle Management允许未授权攻击者入侵企业规划与分析基础设施。

items.reason_en: Affects MySQL Server logging functionality; compromises audit trail integrity which is critical for regulatory compliance and forensic investigations.
items.reason_zh: 影响MySQL Server日志功能；破坏审计轨迹完整性，而该完整性对合规性及取证调查至关重要。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated HTTP exploitation in core infrastructure technology risks destabilizing underlying middleware layers and database connectivity.
items.reason_zh: 核心基础设施技术中存在未授权HTTP利用风险，可能导致底层中间件层及数据库连接不稳定。

items.reason_en: High-severity flaw in installation and configuration routines allows unauthenticated system compromise, threatening overall middleware stability.
items.reason_zh: 安装与配置例程中的高危缺陷允许未授权系统入侵，威胁整体中间件稳定性。

items.reason_en: CVSS 10.0 unauthenticated HTTP vulnerability in Oracle Platform Security for Java allows immediate compromise of core middleware authentication and authorization mechanisms.
items.reason_zh: Oracle Platform Security for Java中存在CVSS评分为10.0的未授权HTTP漏洞，可导致核心中间件认证与授权机制立即被攻破。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.9 flaw in the Oracle Database RDBMS enables low-privileged attackers to escalate privileges via the Oracle Net protocol, threatening database integrity.
items.reason_zh: Oracle Database RDBMS中存在CVSS评分为9.9的缺陷，使低权限攻击者可通过Oracle Net协议提升权限，威胁数据库完整性。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.9 vulnerability in Oracle Text permits network-based compromise of the database server by low-privileged users with session access.
items.reason_zh: Oracle Text中存在CVSS评分为9.9的漏洞，允许具有会话访问权限的低权限用户通过网络入侵数据库服务器。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.8 unauthenticated HTTPS exploit in Oracle APEX poses critical risk to widely deployed low-code application development platforms.
items.reason_zh: Oracle APEX中存在CVSS评分为9.8的未授权HTTPS漏洞，对广泛部署的低代码应用开发平台构成严重风险。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.6 unauthenticated HTTPS vulnerability in Oracle REST Data Services directly impacts API gateway security and backend service exposure.
items.reason_zh: Oracle REST Data Services中存在CVSS评分为9.6的未授权HTTPS漏洞，直接影响API网关安全及后端服务暴露面。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in FrankenPHP's statically linked Brotli extension allows remote attackers to corrupt memory via crafted compressed payloads served by PHP runtimes.
items.reason_zh: FrankenPHP静态链接的Brotli扩展中存在越界写入漏洞，攻击者可借助PHP运行时提供的构造压缩载荷破坏内存。

items.reason_en: SimpleSAMLphp returns unsigned embedded SAML responses before verifying outer signatures, enabling authentication bypass in federated identity and SSO middleware deployments.
items.reason_zh: SimpleSAMLphp在验证外层签名前返回未签名的内嵌SAML响应，导致联合身份认证与单点登录中间件部署中的身份验证绕过。

items.reason_en: Administration REST interface in Azul Payara allows header-based authentication bypass, enabling unauthenticated remote access to middleware management consoles.
items.reason_zh: Azul Payara的管理REST接口允许基于请求头的身份验证绕过，从而实现未经授权的中间件管理控制台远程访问。

items.reason_en: Alternate channel authentication bypass in TIBCO Platform's self-hosted control plane allows unauthorized access to middleware interfaces, risking service disruption.
items.reason_zh: TIBCO Platform自托管控制平面中存在备用通道身份验证绕过漏洞，可导致未经授权访问中间件接口，引发服务中断风险。

items.reason_en: Unverified native library loading from shared temporary locations by MongoDB JDBC drivers allows local privilege escalation on multi-user database hosts.
items.reason_zh: MongoDB JDBC驱动程序从共享临时位置加载未经验证的本地库，可在多用户数据库主机上导致本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: PostgreSQL reindexdb parallel catalog query allows object creators to inject crafted index names, executing arbitrary SQL statements as the running database user.
items.reason_zh: PostgreSQL reindexdb并行编目查询允许对象创建者注入构造的索引名称，从而以当前数据库用户身份执行任意SQL语句。

items.reason_en: hMailServer's database layer fails to bind parameters for MySQL/MariaDB/PostgreSQL, exposing a remote SQL injection vector that allows attackers to alter backend queries.
items.reason_zh: hMailServer数据库层未对MySQL/MariaDB/PostgreSQL正确绑定参数，暴露出远程SQL注入向量，攻击者可借此篡改后端查询。

items.reason_en: Grafana's Elasticsearch data source proxy forwards unrestricted HTTP methods and paths using plugin credentials, enabling index manipulation or cross-index data exfiltration.
items.reason_zh: Grafana的Elasticsearch数据源代理使用插件凭据转发不受限制的HTTP方法与路径，可实现索引篡改或跨索引数据窃取。

items.reason_en: django-tenants fails to escape tenant schema names in PostgreSQL queries, enabling SQL injection that can compromise multi-tenant database structures.
items.reason_zh: django-tenants在PostgreSQL查询中未转义租户模式名称，导致SQL注入漏洞，可能破坏多租户数据库结构。

items.reason_en: The MongoDB C# Driver's BSON serialization library contains a type allow-list bypass that circumvents polymorphic deserialization restrictions.
items.reason_zh: MongoDB C# Driver的BSON序列化库存在类型白名单绕过缺陷，可规避多态反序列化限制。

items.reason_en: File parsing vulnerabilities in llama.cpp allow remote code execution upon opening crafted GGUF model files, impacting local AI inference deployments.
items.reason_zh: llama.cpp的文件解析漏洞允许在打开构造的GGUF模型文件时触发远程代码执行，影响本地AI推理部署。

items.reason_en: Critical CVSS 9.9 vulnerability in Oracle AutoVue enables straightforward remote code execution via HTTP, posing severe risks to document data confidentiality.
items.reason_zh: Oracle AutoVue中存在CVSS评分为9.9的关键漏洞，可通过HTTP轻松实现远程代码执行，严重威胁文档数据机密性。

items.reason_en: Permits low-privileged attackers to compromise Hyperion Financial Management over HTTP, directly endangering sensitive corporate financial records.
items.reason_zh: 允许低权限攻击者通过HTTP入侵Hyperion Financial Management，直接危及敏感的企业财务记录。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated RMI exploitation in Hyperion Planning enables complete module takeover, severely disrupting critical business forecasting operations.
items.reason_zh: Hyperion Planning中存在未授权RMI利用漏洞，可导致模块被完全接管，严重破坏关键业务预测操作。

items.reason_en: Compromises common security subsystems via HTTP, effectively weakening authentication and authorization controls across enterprise deployments.
items.reason_zh: 通过HTTP攻击通用安全子系统，实质性地削弱了企业部署中的身份认证与授权控制。

items.reason_en: Facilitates low-privileged compromise of financial reconciliation processes via HTTP, jeopardizing accurate reporting and financial compliance.
items.reason_zh: 利用HTTP协议以低权限攻破财务对账流程，严重威胁财务报告的准确性与合规性。

items.reason_en: Exploitation of Siebel CRM deployment tools via HTTP threatens customer relationship data integrity and operational continuity.
items.reason_zh: 通过HTTP利用Siebel CRM部署工具，将威胁客户关系数据的完整性及业务连续性。

items.reason_en: Heap out-of-bounds write in BZFlag's TCP message handler allows unauthenticated remote attackers to corrupt memory and execute code within game server processes.
items.reason_zh: BZFlag的TCP消息处理器存在堆越界写入漏洞，允许未认证的远程攻击者破坏内存并在游戏服务器进程中执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Heap out-of-bounds write in Grid Community Toolkit's GSS-API SSLv2 record parsing enables remote code execution on scientific computing and distributed grid services.
items.reason_zh: Grid Community Toolkit的GSS-API在SSLv2记录解析时存在堆越界写入漏洞，可导致科学计算与分布式网格服务遭受远程代码执行攻击。

items.reason_en: Prototype pollution in ExcelJS allows attackers to modify Object.prototype via crafted spreadsheet files, impacting downstream data processing and reporting pipelines.
items.reason_zh: ExcelJS存在原型链污染漏洞，攻击者可利用构造的电子表格文件篡改Object.prototype，进而影响下游数据处理与报表生成流程。

items.reason_en: Pre-sandbox shell execution in the hkuds nanobot agent allows attackers to run arbitrary code before security boundaries are applied, bypassing containment measures.
items.reason_zh: hkuds nanobot代理在沙箱化之前存在Shell执行漏洞，攻击者可在安全边界生效前运行任意代码，从而绕过隔离防护机制。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in NVIDIA Megatron-LM enables code execution and data tampering, threatening AI model training pipelines and integrity.
items.reason_zh: NVIDIA Megatron-LM中存在对不可信数据进行反序列化的漏洞，可导致代码执行与数据篡改，严重威胁AI模型训练流水线的安全性与完整性。

items.reason_en: Eclipse AAS4J validates untrusted XML with JAXP resolving external DTDs and entities, enabling SSRF or local file reads via crafted AAS packages.
items.reason_zh: Eclipse AAS4J在使用JAXP验证不可信XML时错误地解析了外部DTD与实体，攻击者可利用构造的AAS软件包发起SSRF攻击或读取本地文件。

items.reason_en: Open Object Rexx RXAPI blindly trusts client-provided message sizes, causing heap buffer over-reads that can leak sensitive memory or crash applications.
items.reason_zh: Open Object Rexx的RXAPI盲目信任客户端传入的消息长度，引发堆缓冲区越界读取漏洞，可能导致敏感内存信息泄露或应用程序崩溃。

items.reason_en: Fleetdm's user administration API incorrectly authorizes team administrators to grant admin roles on unrelated teams, violating least-privilege principles and enabling lateral privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: Fleetdm的用户管理API存在权限校验缺陷，错误允许团队管理员为无关团队分配管理员角色，违反最小权限原则并可实现横向权限提升。

items.reason_en: Ollama's /api/pull endpoint lacks proper path validation, allowing attackers to traverse directories and drop malicious binaries outside the model storage.
items.reason_zh: Ollama的/api/pull接口缺乏严格的路径校验，攻击者可利用目录穿越漏洞将恶意二进制文件写入模型存储目录之外。

items.reason_en: Git versions prior to 2.50.2 are vulnerable to repository manipulation where an attacker-controlled host can execute arbitrary commands during fetch operations.
items.reason_zh: Git 2.50.2之前的版本存在仓库操纵漏洞，攻击者可通过受控主机在执行fetch操作时注入并执行任意命令。
